description_en: No need to leave the city – Bangkok has its own jungle hideaway 🌴 Natura Café is tucked away in a century-old orchard, with bamboo and wooden structures, canal views, and seating surrounded by tropical plants. Pair it with a coffee and you've got the most therapeutic afternoon ever.
description_zh: 不用出城，曼谷就有叢林秘境 🌴 Natura Café 藏在百年果園裡，竹木建築、運河水景、熱帶植物包圍的座位，配一杯咖啡就是最療癒的午後。
address: 9 Thanon Chom Thong, Khwaeng Chom Thong, Khet Chom Thong, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10150, Thailand

name_en: Heng Chun Seng (Sacred Heart Convent School)
name_zh: Heng Chun Seng (Sacred Heart Convent School)
description_en: Bangkok's Khlong Toei neighborhood is hiding a 72-year-old gem 🍲 Wang Chun Sheng's charcoal-fired beef offal hotpot, where the broth is rich and wonderfully sweet with that nostalgic, old-school flavor. The beef tripe and tendon are so tender they practically melt in your mouth, infused with every bit of that incredible stock. They open at 7am sharp, and locals are already lining up to get their fix.
description_zh: 曼谷 Khlong Toei 藏著一家 72 年老店 🍲 王春盛的炭爐牛雜火鍋，湯頭濃郁帶古早甜味，牛肚牛筋燉得軟嫩入味，早上七點就開門，連本地人都排隊來報到。
address: เลขที่ 8/28 Sunthonkosa Rd, Khwaeng Khlong Tan, Khet Khlong Toei, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: Hidden away on a Surawong corner is this cozy Korean spot 🥩 San Nae Deul where the Korean owner personally tends the grill—the pork belly is so tender it melts in your mouth, and their pure tofu stew is seriously some of Bangkok's best. It feels exactly like having dinner at a Korean friend's home, all warm and welcoming.
description_zh: 藏在蘇拉旺街角的韓式小館 🥩 San Nae Deul 由韓國老闆親自顧爐，五花肉嫩而不柴，純豆腐鍋被封為曼谷最好吃之一，像在韓國朋友家吃飯一樣暖。
address: 1 7 Soi Ekkamai 2, Khwaeng Phra Khanong Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: It's not just a café, it's a six-story coffee experience ☕🌿 Café Amazon Experience sits right next to Ari BTS, and every floor takes you to a different world — from the roastery and matcha bar to the shared workspace. Hit the rooftop and you'll be gazing out at the BTS tracks and the city skyline stretching endlessly before you.
description_zh: 不只是咖啡廳，是六層樓的咖啡體驗 ☕🌿 Café Amazon Experience 就在 Ari BTS 旁，從烘焙坊、抹茶吧到共享辦公室，每層都有不同世界，頂樓還能俯瞰 BTS 軌道與城市天際線。
address: Ari Doi St., Khwaeng Samsen Nai, Khet Phaya Thai, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10400, Thailand

description_en: World-class geisha coffee for just 85 baht ☕ UNO! Coffee is tucked away in the CentralWorld office area, serving competition-grade Geisha Panama at prices that feel almost criminal. People are lining up before they even unlock the doors, so hit them up in the morning to be safe.
description_zh: 世界頂級藝妓咖啡，在這裡只要 85 元 ☕ UNO! Coffee 藏在 CentralWorld 辦公室區，用平價讓你喝到競賽級的 Geisha Panama，開門前就有人排隊，上午來最安全。
address: The Offices At Central World ชั้น, 1 Rama I Rd, Khwaeng Pathum Wan, Pathum Wan, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10330, Thailand

description_en: My Singapore friend said it's even better than Singapore 🍚 Muek Mun Kai is tucked away in a little alley, serving silky-smooth poached chicken with five different dipping sauces for just 69 baht. They sell out by afternoon, so get there early if you want to snag a bowl.
description_zh: 新加坡朋友說比新加坡還好吃 🍚 Muek Mun Kai 藏在小巷裡，嫩滑白斬雞配五種沾醬，一碗才 69 銖，午後就賣完，要來要趁早。
address: 47/1 Soi Phetchaburi 5, Khwaeng Thung Phaya Thai, Khet Ratchathewi, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10400, Thailand

description_en: Hidden in the Ekkamai alley is this dreamy glass house café 🌿 A Keen House is tucked inside a restored three-story shophouse that blends Scandinavian minimalism with Japanese wabi-sabi vibes. Natural light streams through the glass greenhouse seating area, and with a Date Cream Latte in hand, it feels like you've stumbled onto a quiet secret.
description_zh: Ekkamai 巷弄裡的玻璃屋咖啡廳 🌿 A Keen House 由三層老街屋改建而成，北歐簡約混日式侘寂，自然光灑進玻璃溫室座位，配一杯 Date Cream Latte，安靜得像個秘密。
address: 4 Soi Sukjai Sukhumvit 40, Khwaeng Phra Khanong, Khet Khlong Toei, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: The kind of place you dream about after work 🔥 Ekamai Mookata is tucked away in Ekamai Soi 24, with an open-air courtyard and live Thai music setting the vibe. The pork is incredibly tender, the broth is rich and aromatic—grilling, hotpotting, and cold beers all at once. This is exactly how your nights should go.
description_zh: 下班後最想去的那種地方 🔥 Ekamai Mookata 藏在 Ekamai 24 巷，露天庭院配現場泰式音樂，豬肉鮮嫩、湯頭香濃，邊烤邊涮邊喝啤酒，夜晚就該這樣過。
address: 392 Soi Om Sin Sena 3, Khwaeng Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

name_en: ครัวพิศมัย
name_zh: ครัวพิศมัย
description_en: Hidden in the Ratchathewi alleyways is this homestyle Isaan spot 🌶️ ครัวพิศมัย The food is unpretentious and honest—every bite tastes authentically Northeast Thai, with heat that hits just right and salt that's perfectly balanced. It feels like eating at a Thai friend's house.
description_zh: 藏在拉差貼威巷弄裡的家常東北菜 🌶️ ครัวพิศมัย 料理樸實不花俏，每一口都是道地的อีสาน味，辣得過癮、鹹得剛好，像在泰國朋友家裡吃飯。
address: 68/36 Soi Phetchaburi 7, Khwaeng Thung Phaya Thai, Khet Ratchathewi, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10400, Thailand

name_en: ปิ้งเนย สาขาอนุสาวรีย์ชัยฯ
name_zh: ปิ้งเนย สาขาอนุสาวรีย์ชัยฯ
description_en: Just 339 baht for all-you-can-eat AND a Bangkok skyline view 🔥 ปิ้งเนย takes over the rooftop of Victory Hub with open-air grilling that overlooks the BTS Skytrain zipping past below. Grab from over 60 different cuts of beef, seafood, and pork, mix and match between three different types of grills, and eat for as long as you want. This is honestly how every Bangkok night should go.
description_zh: 339 銖吃到飽，還附贈曼谷天際線 🔥 ปิ้งเนย 在 Victory Hub 頂樓露天烤肉，俯瞰 BTS 輕軌穿梭而過，牛肉、海鮮、豬肉超過 60 種食材隨你夾，三種爐具自由搭配，不限時間，夜晚就該這樣過。
address: ชั้น 5 Victory Hub 459 Thanon Ratchawithi, Khwaeng Thanon Phaya Thai, Khet Ratchathewi, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10400, Thailand

description_en: Step into the Ari alleyways and suddenly you're whisked away to Europe 🥐 Landhaus is Bangkok's most authentic German-Austrian bakery, with flour imported straight from Germany. Every day they're baking fresh rye bread, pretzels, and Danish pastries. Grab a cup of coffee in their backyard garden — this is exactly how your weekend mornings should begin.
description_zh: 走進 Ari 小巷，彷彿瞬間飛到歐洲 🥐 Landhaus 是曼谷最道地的德奧麵包坊，麵粉從德國進口，每天現烤黑麥麵包、椒鹽脆餅與丹麥酥，後院花園配一杯咖啡，週末早晨就該這樣開始。
address: 18 Soi Phahonyothin 5, Khwaeng Samsen Nai, Khet Phaya Thai, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10400, Thailand

description_en: Bangkok's most therapeutic afternoon? Spending it with huskies 🐺 TrueLove @ Neverland is tucked away in the residential lanes of Ari, where 30 huskies are waiting to play with you. Two limited sessions daily, so get there early—trust me, these pups are way more popular than you are.
description_zh: 曼谷最療癒的下午，是和哈士奇一起度過的 🐺 TrueLove @ Neverland 藏在 Ari 住宅巷裡，30 隻哈士奇等你來玩，每天兩場限時入場，建議提早到，牠們可比你更受歡迎。
address: 153 Soi Ari Samphan 2, Phaya Thai, Khet Phaya Thai, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10400, Thailand

description_en: Skip Chiang Mai—you can get authentic Northern Thai noodles right in Ari 🍜 Ongtong Khaosoi earned a Michelin recommendation, with ingredients shipped straight from Chiang Mai. The curry broth is rich and silky, the braised beef is tender and packed with flavor, and pair it with their signature chrysanthemum milk—it's the perfect Northern Thai fix all in one bowl.
description_zh: 不用去清邁，在 Ari 就能吃到道地北部麵 🍜 Ongtong Khaosoi 榮獲米其林推薦，食材直送自清邁，咖哩湯頭濃郁香滑，燉牛肉軟嫩入味，再配一杯招牌菊花鮮奶，北部風味一次滿足。
address: 31 Phahonyothin Soi 7, Phaya Thai, Khet Phaya Thai, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10400, Thailand

name_en: Roasted Honey Glazed Pork Mae Sumontha
name_zh: Roasted Honey Glazed Pork Mae Sumontha
description_en: Weekend at Chatuchak? You gotta make a detour for this stall 🍖 Mae Sumantaa's honey-roasted pork is literally legendary in the market — the meat is so tender and juicy, with that perfect sweet-salty balance. Pair it with a piping hot gua bao or sticky rice, and honestly, the smell alone will make you forget how to walk.
description_zh: 週末逛恰圖恰，必繞路來找這攤 🍖 แม่สุมณฑา 的蜂蜜烤豬已是市場傳奇，豬肉鮮嫩多汁、甜鹹恰到好處，配上熱騰騰的刈包或糯米飯，光是香味就讓人走不動腿。
address: 587 โครงการ 22 ซอย 4 /2ตลาดนัด จตุจักร 10 Kamphaeng Phet 2 Rd, Khwaeng Chatuchak, Khet Chatuchak, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10900, Thailand

name_en: เจียงฮวา 江花 Charm ｜เสี่ยวหลงเปา ข้าวหมูพะโล้ และอาหารไต้หวันแท้
name_zh: เจียงฮวา 江花 Charm ｜เสี่ยวหลงเปา ข้าวหมูพะโล้ และอาหารไต้หวันแท้
description_en: In Bangkok, but your heart returns to Taiwan 🍚 Jianghua Taiwan Cuisine is the secret hideout for homesick travelers abroad. When a bowl of braised pork rice hits the table, the rich, glistening meat sauce releases that unmistakable aroma—no words needed, it just tastes like home.
description_zh: 身在曼谷，心回台灣 🍚 江花台灣料理是異鄉遊子的秘密基地，一碗滷肉飯端上桌，油亮的肉燥香氣四溢，那個味道不用多說，就是家的感覺。
address: Chok Chai 4 Soi 28, Khwaeng Lat Phrao, Khet Lat Phrao, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10230, Thailand

description_en: No compromise on vegetarian vibes 🌱 VIBE Coffee is tucked away in a Thonglor alleyway with floor-to-ceiling windows flooding the space with light and keeping everything cozy. Plant-based satay, grilled skewers — you name it, they've got a vegan version, and even the die-hard meat lovers are blown away. Pair it with a smooth Arabica coffee and you're basically floating on cloud nine.
description_zh: 吃素不將就 🌱 VIBE Coffee 藏在 Thonglor 巷弄裡，落地窗採光明亮、空間舒適，植物肉沙嗲、烤豬串通通有素食版，連肉食主義者也說驚艷，配一杯阿拉比卡咖啡，身心都舒暢。
address: 118 สุขุมวิท 36 Soi Saen Sabai, Khwaeng Phra Khanong, Khet Phra Khanong, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: Bangkok's most aromatic basement 🌿 BOTANICESSENCE is tucked away in the underground level of M-Square Plaza, where over a hundred pure natural essential oils are waiting to be discovered. The knowledgeable and friendly staff will help you find your perfect scent match — a true pilgrimage site for fragrance lovers.
description_zh: 曼谷最香的地下室 🌿 BOTANICESSENCE 藏在 M-Square Plaza 地下樓，超過百種純天然精油任你聞，專業又親切的店員帶你找到最對味的那瓶，香氛迷的朝聖地。
address: M-Square Plaza, B1 Floor, Maleenont Tower, Khwaeng Khlong Tan, Klong-Toey Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: Found the homesick-curing Chinese food in Bangkok 🥟 Dong Lai Shun is tucked away in this maze of charming alleyways, where the soup dumplings have paper-thin skins bursting with broth, the Sichuan beef is fiery and addictively delicious, and the fried rice comes with that perfect wok-tossed flavor. The vibe is unpretentious and warm—exactly the kind of spot where locals and Japanese expats flock after work to feel at home.
description_zh: 在曼谷吃到讓人想家的中國菜 🥟 東來順藏在蓬蓬巷弄裡，湯包皮薄汁多、水煮牛肉鮮辣下飯、炒飯鑊氣十足，氛圍樸實溫暖，是當地人和日僑下班後最愛報到的那種地方。
address: 2/52 Soi Sukhumvit 41, Khwaeng Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: Bangkok's most worth-the-wait pork cutlet rice 🥩 Kobe Tonteki is right across from Emsphere. Their signature pork chop is sous-vide slow-cooked until it melts on your tongue, paired with a secret sauce and unlimited refills of fluffy rice and miso soup. One bite and you'll totally get why people queue for this place.
description_zh: 曼谷最值得排隊的豬排飯 🥩 Kobe Tonteki 就在 Emsphere 對面，招牌豬排以舒肥慢煮，嫩到入口即化，搭上秘製醬汁、白飯味噌湯無限續，一吃就明白為什麼要等位。
address: 595, 3-4 Soi Sukhumvit 33/1, Khwaeng Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: Bangkok's most homey Thai restaurant 🌿 Taling Pling is tucked away on Sukhumvit Soi 34, in what used to be the owner's childhood home. With a tropical garden, koi pond, and a century-old mansion wrapped in lush greenery, digging into a bowl of massaman curry or mango sticky rice here feels like coming home. Honestly, it's one of those Bangkok Thai spots totally worth the detour.
description_zh: 曼谷最像「家」的泰式餐廳 🌿 Taling Pling 藏在素坤逸 34 巷，前身是老闆的兒時故居，熱帶花園、魚池、百年老宅，綠意環繞中吃上一份瑪莎曼咖哩或芒果糯米飯，是曼谷最值得特地跑一趟的泰菜之一。
address: 25 Soi Sukhumvit 34, Khwaeng Khlong Tan, Khet Khlong Toei, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: Bangkok's most soul-soothing weekend brunch ☕ Folk Lane by Toby's tucked deep within Sukhumvit 38, a charming red brick vintage house with a lush leafy terrace. Avocado toast and poached egg breakfast plates paired with a specialty coffee — honestly the one place worth making a special trip for on lazy Sunday mornings.
description_zh: 曼谷最療癒的週末早午餐 ☕ Folk Lane by Toby's 藏在素坤逸 38 巷深處，紅磚老屋、綠意露台，酪梨吐司、水波蛋早餐盤搭配一杯精品咖啡，假日早上最值得特地跑一趟的地方。
address: 75 Soi Santi Suk, Khwaeng Phra Khanong, Khet Khlong Toei, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: Bangkok's Secret Korean-Chinese Gem 🍜 Bangkok Banjom is tucked away in the Horizon building in Ekamai, specializing in authentic Korean-Chinese cuisine. Their jjajangmyeon noodles are perfectly chewy with an addictive sauce, and the seafood fried noodles hit you with that fresh, spicy kick that just works. This is the kind of hole-in-the-wall spot that even Koreans themselves can't resist coming back to.
description_zh: 曼谷韓僑的秘密食堂 🍜 Bangkok Banjom 藏在 Ekamai 的 Horizon 大樓裡，專攻道地韓式中華料理，炸醬麵Q彈醬香、海鮮炒碼麵鮮辣夠味，是韓國人自己也愛來的那種小館。
address: Thailand, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon, Soi Sukhumvit 63, Horizon Eakkamai

description_en: By day it's a café, by night it transforms into a bar 🎶 The Office Thonglor is this multi-functional shared space tucked away in the Thonglor sois, with open and comfy seating both indoors and out. Spend your mornings sipping a Biscuit Latte while getting work done in peace, then when night falls, live bands take over the vibe. And yeah, furry friends are totally welcome too.
description_zh: 白天是咖啡廳，晚上變酒吧 🎶 The Office Thonglor 是通羅巷弄裡的多功能共享空間，室內室外座位開闊舒適，白天配一杯 Biscuit Latte 安靜工作，入夜後現場樂團接手，連毛小孩都歡迎入場。
address: 125/1 Soi Sukhumvit 63, 117/1 ถ. ทองหล่อ แขวงคลองตันเหนือ เขตวัฒนา กรุงเทพมหานคร 10110, Thailand

description_en: No need to fly to Tokyo – you can find it right in Thonglor! 🧀 Jerome Cheesecake crafted by a former three-Michelin-star chef. Hokkaido fresh cream paired with Spanish Basque cheese, with a caramelized exterior that gives way to a melt-in-your-mouth center. Every bite feels like a masterpiece from the dessert world.
description_zh: 不用飛東京，在通羅就能吃到 🧀 Jerome Cheesecake 出自前三星米其林主廚之手，北海道鮮奶油搭配西班牙巴斯克起司，表面焦香、內裡入口即化，每一口都像是甜點界的藝術品。
address: ชั้น1 Market Place Thonglor ศูนย์การค้า มาร์เก็ต เพลส เลขที่ 323 Soi Thong Lo, Khwaeng Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

name_en: BARTELS Asok - Sourdough Sandwiches, Coffee & Juicery
name_zh: BARTELS Asok - Sourdough Sandwiches, Coffee & Juicery
description_en: Bangkok's most aromatic mornings start right here 🥖 BARTELS Asok bakes fresh sourdough every single day, never sitting longer than three hours. In this minimalist Nordic space, grab a Fig Toast or smoked ham sandwich paired with a latte, and watch the bread come fresh out of the oven from the second floor — the healing vibes are absolutely off the charts.
description_zh: 曼谷最香的早晨從這裡開始 🥖 BARTELS Asok 每天現烤酸麵包、絕不超過三小時，北歐簡約空間裡，一份 Fig Toast 或煙燻火腿三明治配上一杯拿鐵，還能從二樓看著麵包出爐，療癒指數破表。
address: 199/9-11 Sukhumvit Rd, Khwaeng Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

name_en: The Living Room at Baan Trok Tua Ngork
name_zh: The Living Room at Baan Trok Tua Ngork
description_en: The rebirth of a century-old mansion hidden in the Chinatown alleyways 🏚️ The Living Room is tucked away on the fourth floor of Baan Trok Tua Ngork — a 1920s heritage home lovingly restored by four siblings with their own hands. Lush greenery intertwines with vintage furniture, creating this dreamy suspended-in-time atmosphere where you can gaze out over the rooftops of old Bangkok. Sip your coffee and let the stories of the past wash over you.
description_zh: 唐人街巷弄裡的百年老宅新生 🏚️ The Living Room 藏在 Baan Trok Tua Ngork 四樓，1920 年代古厝由四兄妹親手修繕，綠植與老傢俱交織出時光靜止的氛圍，俯瞰老曼谷屋頂，一杯咖啡配一段往事。
address: Pom Prap, Pom Prap Sattru Phai, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

description_en: A spiritual green oasis in the heart of the bustling city 🌿 Baan Saen Saep sits right along the canal near Siam, with a charming wooden vintage house surrounded by flowers and trees. There's live music, cats roaming around, and freshly baked cakes made daily — it feels like you're just chilling in a friend's living room for the afternoon. They open at 6 AM sharp, more reliable than anyone you know.
description_zh: 鬧市裡的心靈綠洲 🌿 Baan Saen Saep 就在 Siam 附近的運河邊，木造老屋被花草與樹木環繞，有現場音樂、有貓、有每天新鮮現做的蛋糕，像在朋友家客廳消磨一個下午，早上六點開門，比誰都準時。
address: 20 2 Rama I Rd, Khwaeng Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10330, Thailand

name_en: ร้านฮ๊อทพ๊อทหอยย๊า
name_zh: ร้านฮ๊อทพ๊อทหอยย๊า
description_en: Thailand's first-ever! Shellfish hot pot with a fire show at every table 🔥🦪 ฮ๊อทพ๊อทหอยย๊า Hidden away in Ratchada for ages, this place serves up fresh clams and seafood with their signature seafood sauce—and every dish arrives with a dramatic burst of flames. It's seriously delicious AND totally Instagram-worthy. There's only one location, so if you want it, you've gotta make the trip.
description_zh: 泰國首創！每桌都有火焰秀的貝類火鍋 🔥🦪 ฮ๊อทพ๊อทหอยย๊า 在拉差達藏了好久，新鮮蛤蜊、海鮮配上獨門海鮮醬，每道上桌都伴隨火焰噴發，好吃又好拍，只有這一家分店，想吃就得特地來。
address: 617 หมู่ 11 ลาดพร้าง, Khwaeng Lat Phrao, Khet Lat Phrao, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10230, Thailand

description_en: Bangkok's most authentic Neapolitan pizza 🍕 Peppina's flagship spot is tucked away on Sukhumvit Soi 33, with wood-fired ovens turning out crispy, charred-edged perfection. The truffle pizza and clam pasta are absolute must-orders, and it gets so packed at night that you'll struggle to snag a table without reserving ahead.
description_zh: 曼谷最道地的那不勒斯披薩 🍕 Peppina 旗艦店藏在素坤逸 33 巷，木柴窯現烤、餅皮酥脆帶焦香，松露披薩與蛤蜊義大利麵都是必點，熱鬧得晚上常常一位難求，記得提前訂位。
address: 27/1 Soi Sukhumvit 33, Khwaeng Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: Bangkok's most fun bar is right here 🎲 Truth or Dare takes up an entire floor of The Duchess Hotel, with live bands and pool tables out on the terrace, while the indoor DJ gets more fired up as the night goes on. Their cocktail menu is literally named after "Truth" and "Dare," popcorn flows endlessly, and you absolutely need to book ahead on weekends.
description_zh: 曼谷最會玩的酒吧就在這裡 🎲 Truth or Dare 佔據 The Duchess Hotel 一整層，室外有現場樂團與撞球桌，室內 DJ 越夜越燃，雞尾酒單直接以「Truth」和「Dare」命名，爆米花無限供應，週末必訂位。
address: 61 Lang Suan Rd, Khwaeng Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10330, Thailand

description_en: Bangkok's Top Teochew Comfort Food Spot 🦆 Rongsi Pochana is tucked inside Velaa Sindhorn Village, serving five-spice braised duck so tender it melts on your tongue, yellow curry crab stir-fry that's utterly fragrant and rich, and pan-seared oysters with that perfect crispy, caramelized crust. It's like grandma's recipes got a glow-up with gorgeous plating — every dish tastes like home, just elevated.
description_zh: 潮州家常菜裡的曼谷頂流 🦆 Rongsi Pochana 藏在 Velaa Sindhorn Village，五香滷鴨嫩而入味、黃咖哩炒螃蟹鮮香濃郁、生蠔煎酥脆焦香，老食譜遇上精緻擺盤，每道都像外婆的味道升級版。
address: ห้องเลขที่ B107เลขที่ 87 Soi Langsuan, Khwaeng Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10330, Thailand

name_en: Just A Drink Maybe - Bagel Coffee Shop
name_zh: Just A Drink Maybe - Bagel Coffee Shop
description_en: Hidden in the Bangkok alleys, this spot's got serious New York soul 🥯 Just A Drink Maybe freshly hand-bakes bagels every single day—crispy outside, chewy inside—and makes their own cream cheese fresh daily. Build your own with Smoked Salmon, ham and egg, whatever you're craving. The space is calm and spacious with fast WiFi, making it the ultimate secret spot for morning work sessions and coffee lovers.
description_zh: 矽隆巷弄裡的紐約靈魂 🥯 Just A Drink Maybe 每天手工現烤貝果，外酥內Q、自製奶油起司每日新鮮，Smoked Salmon、火腿蛋隨你搭，空間安靜寬敞附快速 WiFi，是晨間工作咖的秘密基地。
address: 37 Soi Silom 9, Si Lom, Khet Bang Rak, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10500, Thailand

description_en: Step into a verdant little eatery straight out of 1970s China 🍜 Chan Charoen sits right on Chan Road, and their signature Southern-style braised pork knuckle rice is absolutely killer — the broth is rich and deeply flavored, the meat falls-off-the-bone tender, and paired with those Cantonese noodles? *Chef's kiss.* The retro ceramic tile walls are so photogenic, everything's wonderfully unpretentious and authentic. It's the kind of hidden gem that Bangkok's true food devotees keep tucked away in their back pocket.
description_zh: 仿若走進 70 年代中國的翠綠小館 🍜 Chan Charoen 就在 Chan Road 上，招牌南派豬腳飯湯頭濃郁、肉質軟嫩，搭上廣東麵條更是一絕，復古磁磚牆面超上鏡，樸實又道地，是曼谷老饕的私藏口袋名單。
address: 264 22-23 Thanon Chan, Khwaeng Wat Phraya Krai, Khet Bang Kho Laem, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10120, Thailand

description_en: Bangkok's most legendary crispy pork, passed down through three generations for fifty years 🐷 Mr. Joe's gravy broth is rich and aromatic with a peppery kick, and the crispy pork belly is perfectly shatteringly-crispy on the outside while staying tender inside—one bite and the juices burst in your mouth. Despite being Michelin-recognized, it stays refreshingly affordable. They open at 7:30 AM, so definitely get there early to grab your spot.
description_zh: 曼谷最強脆皮豬，傳承三代五十年 🐷 Mr. Joe 的粿汁湯頭濃郁帶胡椒香，脆皮豬腩外酥內嫩、一口下去爆汁，米其林掛名卻依然平價，早上七點半開門，建議趁早來報到。
address: 313/7 Thanon Chan, Khwaeng Wat Phraya Krai, Khet Bang Kho Laem, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10120, Thailand

description_en: Grilling meat by the riverside at night—nothing hits quite like this 🔥 Everyday Mookrata Riverside sits right along the Chao Phraya River, where you can watch boats drift by and feel the breeze while charcoal-grilling pork and seafood to live music. This is honestly the most laid-back way to spend a Bangkok evening.
description_zh: 河邊烤肉的夜晚，沒有比這更對了 🔥 Everyday Mookrata Riverside 就坐落在昭披耶河畔，看著船來船往、微風吹過，一邊炭烤豬肉海鮮、一邊配現場音樂，曼谷夜晚最放鬆的方式就是這樣。
address: 23 ซอย โรงน้ำแข็ง Khwaeng Talat Noi, Khet Samphanthawong, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10100, Thailand

description_zh: 像去朋友家吃飯一樣暖 🥩 AantArm Cafe 藏在 Talat Phlu 巷弄裡，牛柳一份才 180 銖，奶油煎得香氣四溢，老闆一家人親切迎客，TikTok 爆紅卻完全不失家常味，早上九點前去排隊才搶得到位子。
description_en: Warm like dining at a friend's place 🥩 AantArm Cafe is tucked away in the Talat Phlu alleyways, beef tenderloin for just 180 baht a plate, butter fried so fragrant it fills the air, the owner's family welcomes you like family, blew up on TikTok but keeps that home-cooked vibe totally intact, get there before 9am and queue up if you want to snag a table.
address: 1231/6 ถ. เทอดไท Khwaeng Talat Phlu, Khet Thon Buri, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10600, Thailand

description_en: Bangkok's one and only rock institution since 1987 🤘 The Rock Pub is a cave-like den covered in rock memorabilia, where live bands shred Metallica, Pantera, and Rage every single night. Nearly four decades in and still the only place in the city for rock and metal lovers — no cover charge, cold beers, and bands that actually know how to play.
description_zh: 搖滾迷在曼谷唯一需要的地方 🤘 The Rock Pub 自 1987 年屹立至今，洞窟風黑牆掛滿搖滾周邊，每晚現場樂團演奏 Metallica、Pantera、Rage Against the Machine，台上台下同樣燃燒，37 年了還是沒有對手。
address: 1011/3-4 Phahon Yothin Road, Phaya Thai, Khet Phaya Thai, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10400, Thailand

description_en: The most soulful night on Khao San Road 🎸 Tucked inside Buddy Lodge Hotel, Brick Bar is all red brick arches and medieval tavern vibes — three live bands a night playing ska and reggae to a crowd of locals and travelers who actually know the words. A thousand people in, yet somehow it still feels like a house party.
description_zh: 考山路最有靈魂的夜晚在這裡 🎸 Brick Bar 藏在 Buddy Lodge Hotel 裡，紅磚拱頂、中世紀酒館氛圍，每晚三場現場樂團輪番上陣演奏 Ska 與 Reggae，本地人與旅人肩並肩跟著唱，容納千人卻像在朋友的地下室派對。
address: Talat Yot, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

description_en: Named after the marigold — Thailand's flower of devotion 🌼 Mariga at Samala Hotel is a quiet gem on Sukhumvit 15, where 28-year-old Chef Khing crafts a culinary journey across every Thai region. Northern hang lay curry, southern chili dips, and a crab roe fried rice that steals the show. Refined, heartfelt, and deeply Thai.
description_zh: 以萬壽菊為名的泰菜殿堂 🌼 Mariga 藏在 Samala Hotel 裡，由年僅 28 歲的主廚 Khing 掌廚，北部掛肉咖哩、南部辣椒蝦醬、螃蟹卵炒飯每道都是對泰國各地風土的深情致敬，細膩而大器。
address: 43 Sukhumvit Soi 15, Nua, Khet Khlong Toei, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: Dining at the table of King Rama V 🕰️ Jirakaan — meaning "once upon a time" — is Bangkok's most enchanting culinary time capsule. The menu revives forgotten royal recipes from the Rattanakosin Era, each dish narrated with history and heart. A century-old tree anchors the dining room, and every bite feels like a page from an old cookbook finally brought to life.
description_zh: 穿越時光回到拉瑪五世的餐桌 🕰️ จิรกาล 以「從前從前」為名，專門復刻曼谷王朝時期近乎失傳的古老食譜，每道菜都是一段泰式飲食史，擁有百年老樹坐落餐廳正中央，氛圍典雅迷人，是曼谷最有靈魂的泰菜體驗之一。
address: 76 Soi Sukhumvit 51, Klongton Nue, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: Bangkok's best eastern Thai cooking, hidden in Soi 33 🦀 Sri Trat is a charming rustic villa with exposed brick walls and a giant mural of the owner's mother — a former Trat beauty queen. The menu brings her coastal recipes to life: tamarind sweet chilli sea bass, spicy crab curry, and chamuang leaf pork that linger long after the meal. Michelin Bib Gourmand, and worth every baht. Book ahead.
description_zh: 曼谷最值得訂位的東部泰菜 🦀 Sri Trat 在素坤逸 33 巷的老磚屋裡，用老闆母親的家傳食譜重現達府海岸風味，酸辣螃蟹咖哩、羅望子甜辣炸鱸魚道道令人難忘，米其林 Bib Gourmand 加持，早點訂位才搶得到。
address: 90 Soi Sukhumvit 33, Khwaeng Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

name_en: Blue Elephant Bangkok Sukhumvit Thai Heritage Cuisine
name_zh: Blue Elephant Bangkok Sukhumvit Thai Heritage Cuisine
description_en: A century-old teak house hiding in the heart of Sukhumvit 🐘 Blue Elephant's Soi 13 outpost is shaded by a giant Monkey Pod tree and worlds away from the street outside. Master Chef Nooror's heritage Thai recipes — rich crab curry, fragrant tom kha, refined pad thai — honour royal culinary traditions with every dish. And the outdoor cocktail bar beneath the canopy? One of Bangkok's most magical spots after dark.
description_zh: 素坤逸鬧區裡的百年柚木老宅 🐘 Blue Elephant Sukhumvit 藏在 Soi 13 深處，巨大雨豆樹遮天蔽日，主廚 Nooror 以宮廷秘方重現泰菜精髓，螃蟹咖哩、香茅椰奶湯每道都像一段歷史，露天雞尾酒吧更是入夜後的曼谷秘境。
address: 27 Soi Sukhumvit 13, Khwaeng Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

name_en: ร้านขจร | Kajohn Authentic Southern Thai Cuisine
name_zh: ร้านขจร | Kajohn Authentic Southern Thai Cuisine
description_en: Southern Thai flavors so authentic, locals from the south say it tastes like home 🦀 Kajohn is tucked in an old shophouse near Wat Saket — seafood sourced fresh from the southern coast, with standout dishes like yellow prawn curry, crispy salted pork belly, and fried squid that keeps regulars coming back. A Google 4.9 rating that's thoroughly earned.
description_zh: 曼谷最道地的南部泰菜，連南部人都說像家鄉味 🦀 ขจร 藏在金山寺附近的老街屋裡，海鮮直送自南部，招牌黃咖哩蝦、炸魷魚、鹹脆五花肉每道都辣得過癮、鮮得剛好，Google 評分 4.9，實至名歸。
address: 245, 4 Thanon Chakkraphatdi Phong, Khwaeng Khlong Maha Nak, Khet Pom Prap Sattru Phai, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10100, Thailand

description_en: A true Thai gem hiding behind a hotel in Nana 🍛 Tamnanthai is the kind of place you almost walk past — and deeply regret if you do. Rich red curry, bold tom yum seafood hotpot, and garlic pork liver that regulars keep coming back for. Warm family service, honest flavors, and prices that make it even harder to leave.
description_zh: 藏在 Nana 飯店後巷的道地泰菜秘境 🍛 Tamnanthai 遠離觀光喧囂，紅咖哩、冬蔭海鮮鍋、蒜炒豬肝每道都鮮香夠味，老闆娘親切招呼像家人，來過三次還是想再回來的那種店。
address: 18 Soi Sukhumvit 4, Khwaeng Khlong Toei, Khet Khlong Toei, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: This isn't just Thai food — it's Aunty Ying's cuisine 🌿 Oranuch is tucked inside a traditional Thai house on Sukhumvit 23, surrounded by lush greenery and warm candlelight. The Penang curry is deeply aromatic, the crab curry hits every note, and the owner herself often comes out to welcome guests. One of Bangkok's most underrated gems — and one of its most memorable meals.
description_zh: 這裡不只是泰菜，是 Aunty Ying 的料理 🌿 Oranuch 藏在素坤逸 23 巷的傳統泰式老宅裡，花木扶疏、燈光溫柔，Penang 咖哩濃郁芬芳、螃蟹咖哩鮮辣過癮，每一道都像是老闆娘親手為你烹調，是曼谷最值得穿越叢林去找的那一家。
address: 36/1 Soi Sukhumvit 23, คลองเตย Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: A creative Thai kitchen hiding in plain sight at Trinity Mall 🍽️ BIB: Break in Bangkok blends bold Thai flavors with modern twists — salted egg spaghetti, beef fat fried rice, and grilled beef tongue that keeps diners coming back. Cozy, intimate, and just inventive enough to surprise you every visit. Reservations recommended.
description_zh: 矽隆的隱藏版創意泰菜 🍽️ BIB: Break in Bangkok 藏在 Trinity Mall 角落，鹹蛋黃義大利麵、牛油炒飯、烤牛舌一道比一道驚喜，泰式靈魂遇上現代手法，空間小巧溫馨、建議提前訂位。
address: Trinity Mall, 425 Si Lom 3, Si Lom, Khet Bang Rak, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10500, Thailand

description_en: A 31-spice family recipe that takes you straight to Chiang Mai 🍜 Khao-Sō-i Soi Convent is tucked just off Silom — rich, aromatic curry broth, silky fresh noodles, and your choice of beef, pork, chicken, or seafood. Free-flow drinks and a welcoming vibe make it one of the best Northern Thai spots near BTS Sala Daeng.
description_zh: 31 種香料秘傳湯底，一口就回到清邁 🍜 Khao-Sō-i Soi Convent 藏在矽隆巷弄裡，咖哩湯頭濃郁芬芳、麵條彈滑入味，牛肉、豬肉、海鮮任你選，飲料無限續，是 Sala Daeng 站附近最值得繞路的北部料理。
address: 14/2-3 Convent Rd, Si Lom, Khet Bang Rak, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10500, Thailand

description_en: Bangkok's most exciting new fire-kitchen 🔥 Tucked in Trinity Complex on Silom Soi 5, Silo puts its open-flame kitchen front and centre — chefs working live heat in full view, crafting bold dishes like crispy softshell crab, smoky leek with romesco, and a sticky toffee pudding with a savory twist. Only open Wednesday to Sunday, and already one of the hottest tables in the city.
description_zh: 明火料理的新生代殿堂 🔥 Silo 藏在矽隆 5 巷的 Trinity Complex 裡，開放式廚房以炭火為靈魂，軟殼蟹、烤韭蔥、黏太妃布丁每道都是精心之作，2026 年剛開幕就引爆話題，週三至週日限定，值得提前訂位。
address: 425, 4 Soi Silom 5, Si Lom, Khet Bang Rak, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10500, Thailand

description_en: From humble street stall to Michelin-recommended gem 🦑 lay lao in Silom is now one of Bangkok's most talked-about Isaan restaurants — marinated crab rice, melt-in-your-mouth grilled pork neck, and perfectly tender squid under Bangkok's most dramatic chandelier. Steps from the MRT, ice-cold AC, and worth every minute of the queue.
description_zh: 矽隆裡最大枝燈的東北泰菜 🦑 lay lao 從不起眼街邊攤蛻變成米其林推薦餐廳，醃螃蟹飯、烤豬頸肉、彈牙鮮魷每道都讓人想再點一輪，緊鄰 MRT 站、冷氣超強，是下班後最想衝的那一家。
address: 56 Silom Rd (Yada Building สีลม Khwaeng Suriya Wong, Khet Bang Rak, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10500, Thailand

description_en: Bangkok's most romantic rooftop 🍷 Scarlett Wine Bar sits on the 37th floor of Pullman Bangkok Hotel G — over 250 wines, a French cheese counter that rivals any in Paris, and sweeping views of the Chao Phraya at sunset. The kind of evening that slows everything down in the best possible way.
description_zh: 曼谷最浪漫的法式紅頂 🍷 Scarlett 坐落在 Pullman Hotel G 37 樓，超過 250 款佳釀、法國起司拼盤、昭披耶河夜景三位一體，日落後入座、點一杯紅酒，曼谷的夜晚在這裡變得無比優雅。
address: 188 Si Lom Rd, Khwaeng Suriya Wong, Khet Bang Rak, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10500, Thailand

description_en: Street food soul in a polished setting 🍛 SOI Bangkok draws inspiration from Bangkok's iconic alleyways — hand-crafted panaeng and green curries, smoky grilled skewers, and bold Thai flavours done right. Ranked top 150 in Bangkok on TripAdvisor, yet somehow it still feels like your favourite neighbourhood spot.
description_zh: 街頭魂、精品心 🍛 SOI Bangkok 以曼谷巷弄街食為靈感，瑪沙曼咖哩從頭手工熬製、烤串酥香帶炭火香氣，TripAdvisor 排名曼谷前 150，卻保留了那股隨興親切的小館氛圍，是讓人一來再來的那種店。
address: 195 N Sathon Rd, Si Lom, Khet Bang Rak, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10500, Thailand

description_en: Bangkok's coolest steakhouse 🥩 Nestled inside The Standard at MahaNakhon, The Standard Grill serves Rangers Valley Black Angus sirloin, a juicy chateaubriand, and truffle mac and cheese that regulars keep coming back for. Gorgeous interiors, top-notch service, and the kind of meal that makes any occasion feel special.
description_zh: 曼谷最帥氣的牛排館 🥩 The Standard Grill 坐落在 MahaNakhon 大廈裡，Rangers Valley 黑安格斯沙朗、夏多布里昂牛排搭上松露起司通心粉，空間設計時尚大器，服務無微不至，是特殊場合值得好好犒賞自己的地方。
address: 5th Floor, The Standard, Bangkok Mahanakhon, 114 Narathiwas Road, Si Lom, Khet Bang Rak, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10500, Thailand

description_en: Bangkok's most seductive dining room since 1998 🍷 Eat Me hides on Convent Road behind lush greenery — step inside to dim lighting, provocative gallery art, and a menu where Australian ingredients meet Asian instinct. Truffle risotto, duck confit, award-winning cocktails, and a kitchen that runs until 1am. Five-time Asia's 50 Best alumni, and still one of Bangkok's most memorable nights out.
description_zh: 曼谷最性感的餐廳自 1998 年起就是這家 🍷 Eat Me 藏在 Convent Road 巷弄裡，昏暗燈光、當代藝術裝飾，美式主廚以澳洲食材融入亞洲靈魂，松露奶油燉飯、烤鴨胸、創意調酒每道都是享樂主義的宣言，曾五度進榜亞洲 50 最佳餐廳，廚房開到凌晨一點。
address: 1, 6 Phiphat 2, Si Lom, Khet Bang Rak, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10500, Thailand

name_en: Khun Ake Mam Ari Pad Thai
name_zh: Khun Ake Mam Ari Pad Thai
description_en: Ari's legendary street-side pad thai 🍜 Monocle-endorsed and loved by locals for over 20 years, Khun Ake Mam's wok-tossed pad thai is as good as it gets — bold, smoky, not too sweet, starting at just 50 baht. Pair it with the impossibly crispy mussel omelette. Opens evenings only, so don't miss your window.
description_zh: Ari 在地人的傳奇街頭炒麵 🍜 คุณเอกแม่มอารีย์ 是 Monocle 欽點的 Ari 最佳 Pad Thai，老闆娘炒了 20 年、每鍋大火鑊氣十足，一盤才 50 銖，配上酥脆蚵仔煎，只在傍晚開門，想吃要趁早。
address: 1, 4 Soi Phahon Yothin 7, Phaya Thai, Khet Phaya Thai, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10400, Thailand

description_en: Ari's most beautiful spice bomb 🌶️ Paknang sits in a pastel-hued multi-storey shophouse near Ari Soi 5 — Wes Anderson vibes outside, fiery Southern Thai heat inside. The dry kua kling curry and grilled shrimp with turmeric sticky rice are not for the faint-hearted. Monocle-endorsed and beloved by locals who know their way around a chilli.
description_zh: Ari 最美味的南部炸彈 🌶️ Paknang 藏在 Ari 5 巷多層老街屋裡，粉嫩復古色調有點 Wes Anderson 的味道，但菜單可一點都不溫柔，Kua Kling 乾咖哩、南部烤蝦搭薑黃糯米飯道道辣得過癮，是 Monocle 欽點的 Ari 必吃之一。
address: 2/23, 5 ซ. พหลโยธิน 7 แขวงพญาไท เขตพญาไท กรุงเทพมหานคร 10400, Thailand

description_en: Seven consecutive Michelin Bib Gourmands — and still Ari's favourite table 🦑 The original lay lao draws its soul from Hua Hin's coastline, with seafood delivered fresh daily. Grilled pork neck that regulars order twice, chunky crab fried rice, and squid that's tender with a fragrant spicy kick. Rustic chilli-covered walls, open daily, and reservations strongly recommended.
description_zh: 連續七年米其林 Bib Gourmand，Ari 的靈魂食堂 🦑 lay lao 本店以華欣鮮海鮮為靈魂，烤豬頸肉軟嫩焦香、螃蟹炒飯粒粒飽滿、炸透抽彈牙帶香辣，農舍風牆面掛滿辣椒，是 Ari 居民的日常、外地人的朝聖地。
address: 65 Soi Phahon Yothin 7, Khwaeng Samsen Nai, Khet Phaya Thai, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10400, Thailand

description_en: Ari's best late-night pizza fix 🍕 Kenny's BKK does stone-baked pizza with a perfectly charred crust, alongside standout bites like corn ribs and burrata salads. Cold craft beer, friendly vibes, and open until 3am — the kind of neighbourhood spot that gets better as the night goes on.
description_zh: Ari 巷弄裡的深夜披薩救星 🍕 Kenny's BKK 石窯現烤、餅皮酥脆有嚼勁，玉米肋排、Burrata 沙拉前菜驚喜連連，精釀啤酒單選擇多元，開到凌晨三點，是 Ari 夜貓子的秘密據點。
address: 12, 5 ถ. พหลโยธิน Phayathai, เขตพญาไท กรุงเทพมหานคร 10400, Thailand

name_en: ถึงเจียงใหม่ บางกอก | Thungchiangmai bangkok
name_zh: ถึงเจียงใหม่ บางกอก | Thungchiangmai bangkok
description_en: Real Chiang Mai flavours, no flight required 🍜 Thungchiangmai Bangkok has earned five consecutive Michelin Bib Gourmands for its honest Northern Thai home cooking — laab moo kua, northern sausage, and bold mountain-spiced dishes that locals from Chiang Mai say taste just like home. Tucked quietly in Ari Soi 1, open Monday to Saturday only.
description_zh: 不用去清邁，在 Ari 就能吃到真正的北部味 🍜 ถึงเจียงใหม่ 連續五年米其林 Bib Gourmand，炒豬肉拉布、北部香腸道地夠味，口味是清邁人自己認證的那種，藏在 Ari 1 巷安靜角落，週一至週六開門，值得特地繞路來。
address: Soi Phahon Yothin 7, Phaya Thai, Khet Phaya Thai, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10400, Thailand

name_en: The Island Bangkok – Top Rated Thai Restaurant & Bar
name_zh: The Island Bangkok – Top Rated Thai Restaurant & Bar
description_en: A tropical island hideaway steps from Khaosan 🌴 The Island Bangkok is tucked down Samsen Soi 4 — swing seats, warm lighting, and a multi-floor space that actually feels like an escape. Excellent Thai curries, generous portions, a dedicated vegan menu, and open until 2am. The calmer, more charming alternative to the Khaosan chaos just around the corner.
description_zh: 考山路旁的熱帶小島秘境 🌴 The Island Bangkok 藏在 Samsen 4 巷，多層樓座位搭上鞦韆椅、昏黃燈光，泰式綠咖哩、Panang 咖哩道道鮮香，還有素食專屬菜單，每天開到凌晨兩點，是比考山路更有靈魂的夜晚選擇。
address: 49 Soi Samsen 4, Khwaeng Ban Phan Thom, Khet Phra Nakhon, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10200, Thailand

description_en: Your go-to Vietnamese fix in Ari 🥖 Sawasdee Bánh Mì is tucked inside Centric Ari — crispy baguettes stuffed generously with meat and veggies, fresh gỏi cuốn spring rolls, and comforting bowls of pho, all between 80–150 baht. Simple, satisfying, and the best value quick bite in the neighbourhood.
description_zh: Ari 巷弄裡的越南小確幸 🥖 Sawasdee Bánh Mì 就在 Centric Ari 裡，法棍外酥內軟、餡料紮實豐富，生春捲、越南河粉一應俱全，80–150 銖的親民價格在 Ari 絕對稱得上良心小店，想找個快速又好吃的午餐，就是這裡了。
address: 27 Phahon Yotin 5, Phaya Thai, Khet Phaya Thai, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10400, Thailand

description_en: Chinatown's coolest dim sum spot 🥟 HAGOW sits in a two-storey retro shophouse on Yaowarat Road — open kitchen, Hong Kong vibes, and a menu starring crystal-clear har gow, crispy pan-fried noodles, and rich braised pork belly. The perfect pit stop on a Chinatown night out, with the neon glow of Yaowarat right outside the window.
description_zh: 耀華力最潮的港式飲茶 🥟 HAGOW 藏在中國城兩層老街屋裡，開放式廚房現包蝦餃晶瑩剔透、脆皮炒麵鑊氣十足、紅燒豬腩入口即化，復古港風裝潢配上耀華力霓虹夜色，是老唐人街最新鮮的打卡體驗。
address: 387 Yaowarat Rd, Khwaeng Samphanthawong, Khet Samphanthawong, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10100, Thailand

description_en: Where Chinatown meets Mexico 🌮 Cholos' newest outpost sits on the corner of Yaowarat Road — neon signs with Chinese script, lanterns overhead, and the same bold Cali-Mex menu that made Bangkok finally take Mexican food seriously. Slow-cooked birria tacos, grilled cheese with dipping broth, and frozen margaritas from chefs who trained at Gaggan and Gaa. A collision of cultures that genuinely works.
description_zh: 中國城遇上墨西哥 🌮 Cholos 最新分店落腳耀華力路口，中式霓虹燈籠混搭墨西哥風，由前 Gaggan、Gaa 主廚打造，慢燉牛肉塔可、Birria 起司吐司、冷凍瑪格麗特，是曼谷認真對待墨西哥料理的第一人。
address: Unit 194 Yaowarat Rd, Khwaeng Samphanthawong, Khet Samphanthawong, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10100, Thailand

description_en: Chinatown's most legendary bowl since the 1960s 🍜 Nai Ek started as a humble pushcart on Yaowarat Road and earned a Michelin Bib Gourmand along the way. Their guay jub is the real deal — peppery clear broth, chewy rolled rice noodles, and crispy pork belly that somehow stays crunchy in the soup. Open 8am to midnight daily. The queue moves fast; just join it.
description_zh: 耀華力最傳奇的一碗麵 🍜 Nai Ek 從 60 年代街頭推車做起，如今是中國城的米其林 Bib Gourmand 地標，捲粉湯底胡椒香氣撲鼻、脆皮豬腩酥到泡在湯裡都不軟，早上八點開到凌晨，排隊是必要儀式。
address: 442 ซอย 9, Khwaeng Samphanthawong, Khet Samphanthawong, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10100, Thailand

name_en: ไฟเขียวเยาวราช Fikeaw Yaowarat
name_zh: ไฟเขียวเยาวราช Fikeaw Yaowarat
description_en: Chinatown's most addictive open-air seafood spot 🦞 ไฟเขียว on Yaowarat Soi 11 is pure street-food theatre — pick your lobster, river prawns, or fish, watch the chef work blazing wok fire, and dig into garlic butter lobster and crispy fried red snapper that keep people coming back trip after trip. Opens at 6pm. The queue is worth every minute.
description_zh: 耀華力最值得排隊的海鮮攤 🦞 ไฟเขียว 就在耀華力 11 巷路邊，自選龍蝦、河蝦、鮮魚，大火鑊氣現炒，蒜蓉奶油龍蝦鮮甜無比，炸紅鯛外酥內嫩，有人來曼谷連吃五次、每次都不失望，傍晚六點開始、排隊是值得的儀式。
address: Soi Yaowarat 11, Khwaeng Chakkrawat, Khet Samphanthawong, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10100, Thailand

description_en: Bangkok's most intimate French alpine hideaway 🏔️ Tucked behind a wooden gate on Sathorn Soi 10, Maison Dunand is Michelin-starred Chef Arnaud's deeply personal love letter to the French Alps — a cosy chalet-style space where a seven-course degustation menu weaves Alpine memories with Asian ingredients. The cheese trolley with 20+ French selections is a highlight. A meal here doesn't just satisfy; it lingers.
description_zh: 曼谷最私密的法式阿爾卑斯小屋 🏔️ Maison Dunand 藏在 Sathorn 10 巷深處，米其林一星主廚 Arnaud 以薩瓦山區的童年記憶為靈感，七道菜品味套餐細膩而充滿故事，超過 20 款法國起司推車是全場亮點，搭配侍酒師精選，是曼谷最值得為之慶祝的一頓飯。
address: 55 Sathon Soi 10, Si Lom, Khet Bang Rak, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10500, Thailand

description_en: Thai culinary heritage, elevated to a Michelin star 🌿 Saawaan is Chef Aom's deeply personal nine-course love letter to Thailand — each dish built around a traditional technique like charcoal grilling, steaming, or fermentation, using locally sourced ingredients from across the country. Tea pairing or wine pairing both shine. One of Bangkok's most unforgettable fine-dining experiences, full stop.
description_zh: 泰菜精髓的米其林一星詮釋 🌿 Saawaan 由主廚 Aom 掌舵，以九道季節性套餐重新詮釋泰國各地傳統烹飪技法，炭烤、蒸製、發酵每道都是一趟地方風土之旅，搭配泰式森林茶或選酒，是曼谷最值得珍藏的一夜。
address: 39, 19 Soi Suanplu, Khwaeng Thung Maha Mek, Khet Sathon, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10120, Thailand

description_en: Bangkok's most storied colonial mansion 🏛️ Built in 1889, The House on Sathorn has been a private residence, a luxury hotel, and the Soviet embassy — and now it's Bangkok's most atmospheric bar and dining venue beside W Bangkok. Crystal chandeliers, dark wood panelling, and a leafy courtyard that feels worlds away from Sathorn's skyscrapers. The cocktails at Bar Sathorn are reason enough to visit alone.
description_zh: 曼谷最有故事的百年老宅 🏛️ The House on Sathorn 建於 1889 年，歷經豪宅、飯店、前蘇聯大使館，如今化身為 W Bangkok 旁最迷人的餐酒館，水晶吊燈、深色木造廊柱、中庭花園，Bar Sathorn 雞尾酒單一杯抵千言，是連曼谷本地人都愛來的地方。
address: 106, 108 N Sathon Rd, Si Lom, Khet Bang Rak, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10500, Thailand

description_en: A love letter to grandmother, plated with Michelin precision 👵🏻 Lahnyai is Chef Ton's intimate tribute to royal Thai family recipes — reinterpreted with white truffle, local caviar, and black truffle in a velvet-walled space of only ten seats. Mirrored ceilings, family photos, and embroidered chairs set the scene. A deeply personal and unforgettable tasting menu. Book well in advance.
description_zh: 獻給外婆的宮廷泰菜詩篇 👵🏻 Lahnyai 出自 Le Du 主廚 Ton 之手，以祖母食譜為靈感、以現代技法重詮皇室泰菜，僅十個座位、鏡頂綠牆家族照片環繞，松露白蘭地蒸蛋佐螃蟹魚子醬每道都是傳承與創新的對話，米其林入選、訂位提前一個月起。
address: LAHNYAI, 31 ซอย สวนพลู 2 Mahamek, เขตสาทร กรุงเทพมหานคร 10120, Thailand

description_en: A tropical fairytale hidden in Sathorn's urban jungle 🌿 Park Sathorn is a colonial wooden mansion surrounded by waterfalls, koi ponds, and towering trees on Sathorn Soi 1. The menu spans Thai classics and Italian dishes, with crab curry and tom yum as standouts. Equal parts stunning and serene — one of Bangkok's most Instagrammable escapes that actually delivers on atmosphere.
description_zh: 走進 Sathorn 最美的熱帶仙境 🌿 Park Sathorn 藏在 Sathorn 1 巷的殖民式老宅裡，流水瀑布、錦鯉池塘、百年老樹環繞，泰式螃蟹咖哩、冬蔭功蝦與義式料理並列菜單，是 TikTok 爆紅的打卡聖地，卻比外表更有底蘊。
address: 24 Soi Si Akson, Khwaeng Thung Maha Mek, Khet Sathon, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10120, Thailand

description_en: Bangkok's most fun Italian restaurant 🍝🕺 Capricci on Soi Yen Akat 1 is the playful side project of Michelin-starred chefs Arnaud Dunand and Christian Martena — handmade pasta, truffle toast, wood-fired hanger steak, and piadinas, all served to a groovy Italo-Disco soundtrack. Stand at the bar, order a Negroni or Spritz, and let the aperitivo culture do the rest. Molto amore, always.
description_zh: 曼谷最歡樂的義式迪斯可餐廳 🍝🕺 Capricci 由 Maison Dunand 與 Clara 兩位米其林主廚聯手打造，手工義大利麵、松露吐司、炭烤肋眼配上復古 Italo-Disco 音樂，Negroni 一杯接一杯，像在朋友家開派對一樣自在，Yen Akat 巷弄裡最熱鬧的一夜。
address: 26/3 Thanon Yen Akat, Khwaeng Thung Maha Mek, Khet Sathon, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10120, Thailand

description_en: The world's first Thai rooftop restaurant, and it delivers 🌆 Le Du Kaan sits on the 56th floor of The Empire in Sathorn — Michelin-starred Chef Ton's sky-high spin-off where seasonal Thai ingredients meet panoramic Bangkok views. Lobster pad thai, grilled pork collar, and squid papaya salad with the Chao Phraya River on one side and MahaNakhon on the other. Book ahead, arrive at sunset, and let the DJ take care of the rest.
description_zh: 世界首座泰式天空餐廳 🌆 Le Du Kaan 坐落 Empire Tower 56 樓，米其林主廚 Ton 以季節食材為核心，龍蝦泰式炒河粉、炭烤豬頸肉、魷魚木瓜沙拉道道精彩，一側是昭披耶河、另一側是 MahaNakhon 天際線，夕陽入座、DJ 接夜，是曼谷最難忘的一頓飯。
address: 56th Floor The Empire, 1 S Sathon Rd, Khwaeng Yan Nawa, Khet Sathon, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10120, Thailand

name_en: รสกรุง - Ros Krung Esarn Thai Cafe
name_zh: รสกรุง - Ros Krung Esarn Thai Cafe
description_en: Old Bangkok's hidden Isaan gem 🌶️ Tucked on Maha Chai Road near Pra Tu Phi, Ros Krung serves authentic northeastern Thai comfort food with a modern twist — punchy som tam, flavourful larb, and beautifully plated dishes that punch well above their price point. The perfect pit stop after exploring Rattanakosin's temples and markets.
description_zh: 曼谷老城區的東北泰菜小驚喜 🌶️ รสกรุง 藏在馬哈猜路上，現代裝潢融入傳統泰式元素，青木瓜沙拉、拉布肉末道地夠辣，擺盤精緻超乎預期，價格親民氣氛輕鬆，是逛完唐人街或大皇宮後最值得繞進去吃一頓的地方。
address: 337 Maha Chai Rd, Khwaeng Samran Rat, Khet Phra Nakhon, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10200, Thailand

description_en: Chinatown's most cinematic late-night hideaway 🦆 Madame K on Soi Nana is a personality-driven gem run by a Singaporean-Thai couple — blending Northern Thai Lanna cooking with Peranakan roots. Duck confit khao soi, crispy oysters, and jackfruit with pork sit alongside cocktails inspired by 1950s Chinatown folklore and triads. Moody interiors, the occasional fire-eating performance, and open till 1am. Bangkok's most interesting night out.
description_zh: 中國城最有個性的深夜食堂 🦆 Madame K 藏在 Soi Nana 巷弄裡，由新泰夫妻檔打造，北泰 Lanna 料理遇上娘惹風味，鴨肉酥脆貼葉、鴨肉卡樂蘇伊、炸蠔驚喜連連，一樓是復古上海酒吧、雞尾酒靈感取自老唐人街黑幫傳說，偶有噴火表演，週二至週日開到深夜。
address: 125 Soi Ram Maitri, subdistrict, Khet Pom Prap Sattru Phai, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10100, Thailand

description_en: Old Bangkok's most soulful jazz dinner 🎷 Din sits inside a lovingly restored 125-year-old gunpowder house on Dinso Road, just steps from the Grand Palace. Thai beef curry, beef tongue stew, crispy duck leg, and inventive cocktails — all underscored by nightly live jazz through a vintage JBL Paragon sound system. The kind of evening that makes Bangkok's old town feel like a different world entirely.
description_zh: 老曼谷最有靈魂的爵士晚餐 🎷 Din 藏在 125 年歷史的前火藥庫改建的 Baan Tuk Din 裡，泰式牛肉咖哩、牛舌燉、脆皮炸鴨腿配上每晚現場爵士樂，JBL Paragon 音響讓每個音符都流進骨子裡，大皇宮旁的古城夜晚就該這樣度過。
address: 161, 165 Dinso Rd, Khwaeng Wat Bowon Niwet, Khet Phra Nakhon, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10200, Thailand

description_en: Khaosan Road's best-kept dining secret 🍕 With a Google rating of 4.8, Olive Kitchen punches well above its surroundings — tom yum prawn spaghetti, handmade spinach ravioli, and proper Neapolitan pizza made with house-stretched dough. Air-conditioned seating upstairs, pizza takeaway until 1am, and a team that genuinely cares. The kind of place that makes you want to stay in the neighbourhood one more night.
description_zh: 考山路上最讓人驚喜的義泰融合小館 🍕 Olive Kitchen Google 評分 4.8，Tom Yam 海鮮義大利麵、手工起司義大利餃、那不勒斯窯烤披薩道道用心，冷氣二樓座位舒適涼爽，外帶披薩到凌晨一點，是逃離考山喧囂的最佳避風港。
address: 28/10, Khwaeng Chana Songkhram, Khet Phra Nakhon, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10200, Thailand

description_en: All-you-can-eat riverside seafood, no time limit 🦞 Kodtalay sits right on the Chao Phraya River — for just 600+ baht, you get live prawns and crabs to catch and grill yourself, plus sashimi, Thai dishes, teppanyaki, and dim sum spread across the table. Arrive between 4–5pm to snag a river-view spot and catch the sunset turning the water gold. One of Bangkok's best-value nights out, full stop.
description_zh: 昭披耶河畔吃到飽，蝦蟹生猛無限量 🦞 Kodtalay 坐落河岸邊，600 多銖不限時，活蝦活蟹自己撈自己烤，生魚片、泰式料理、日式鐵板燒一字排開，傍晚四點入座搶河景位、看夕陽把河面染成金色，這一餐值回票價。
address: 11, 3 Soi Charoen Krung 58, Khwaeng Yan Nawa, Khet Sathon, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10120, Thailand

description_en: Yaowarat's freshest seafood without the wait 🦐 Herethep on the main Chinatown strip sources daily from the pier — five jumbo prawns for 199 baht, a punchy tom yum that hits every note, and air-conditioned comfort on the second floor with a perfect view of the Chinatown neon below. Six minutes from MRT Wat Mangkon, and no queue. The same owner runs the legendary Tanbo Chicken Rice next door.
description_zh: 耀華力最值得繞路的海鮮老鋪 🦐 เฮียเทพ 就在中國城主街上，海鮮直送碼頭、每天新鮮，五隻大明蝦才 199 銖，冬蔭功湯鮮辣夠勁，二樓有冷氣、MRT 走路六分鐘，不用排隊就能吃到讚不絕口的水準。
address: 303 Yaowarat Rd, Khwaeng Samphanthawong, Khet Samphanthawong, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10100, Thailand

description_en: The seafood buffet Bangkok taxi drivers actually recommend 🦀 Mungkorn Seafood in Rama 3 keeps it simple and spectacular — 499 baht, no time limit, live prawns and crabs you catch and grill yourself, plus mountains of pre-cooked seafood, fresh fruit, and desserts. Google 4.9 from over 13,000 reviews. A little out of the way, and absolutely worth every minute of the ride.
description_zh: 曼谷計程車司機私藏推薦的海鮮天堂 🦀 Mungkorn Seafood 499 銖不限時，活蝦活蟹自己撈自己烤，螃蟹、瀨尿蝦、整尾魚任你選，再配上山竹糯米飯畫下完美句點，Google 4.9 分、13,000 則評價撐腰，值得特地跑一趟 Rama 3。
address: 373/1 Soi Suk Sawat 27, Khwaeng Rat Burana, Khet Rat Burana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10140, Thailand

description_en: Thong Lo's best-kept seafood secret 🦞 SEA Bangkok hides in a residential soi with no flashy signs — just exceptional seafood. Charcoal grilled river prawns, crab fried rice, and a signature Sea Sauce that fuses Singapore chilli crab with Thai flavours in a way that's completely its own. Cash only, limited tables, and reviews that say "completely flawless." Book ahead.
description_zh: 通羅巷弄裡的隱藏版海鮮神店 🦞 SEA Bangkok 藏在住宅巷子深處，炭烤大頭蝦鮮甜帶焦香、螃蟹炒飯粒粒飽滿，招牌 Sea Sauce 融合新加坡辣蟹醬與泰式風味，桌桌都有人讚不絕口，只收現金、座位有限，訂位是必要功課。
address: 399 93 21 Sukhumvit 55 Khwaeng Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: The crab restaurant founded by cricket legends 🦀 Ministry of Crab was created by Sri Lanka's most celebrated cricketers — and the crabs live up to the legacy. Flown fresh from Sri Lanka, never frozen, with the Crabzilla topping 2kg and a black pepper sauce that earns its own fan club. Tucked in Sukhumvit Soi 31, this is Bangkok's most theatrical seafood experience. Book well ahead.
description_zh: 斯里蘭卡板球傳奇帶來的螃蟹朝聖地 🦀 Ministry of Crab 由前板球國手 Mahela 與 Sangakkara 創辦，活螃蟹直送自斯里蘭卡、絕不冷凍，招牌 Crabzilla 重達兩公斤以上，黑胡椒與奶油蒜香二選一都是絕配，素坤逸 31 巷的精緻用餐體驗，訂位是必要的。
address: 15, 1 Sukhumvit 31, Khwaeng Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: Dinner with Wat Arun lighting up right in front of you 🌅 Horsamut sits on the Chao Phraya riverside with one of Bangkok's most breathtaking views — and the coastal Thai food keeps pace with the scenery. Charcoal-grilled snakehead fish, refreshing pomelo salad, and dishes drawing from Hat Yai, Surat Thani, and Trat. Arrive at sunset, stay until the Temple of Dawn glows. A meal that earns its view.
description_zh: 鄭王廟就在眼前，這頓飯沒有理由不美 🌅 Horsamut 坐落昭披耶河畔，泰國各地沿海風味在此匯聚，酸辣帽貝沙拉、炭烤鱧魚配羅望子醬、柚子蒸魚道道用心，夕陽將河面染成金色時入座，Wat Arun 亮燈後起身，是曼谷最值得為之慢下來的一餐。
address: 8 Soi Tha Kham, Khwaeng Phra Borom Maha Ratchawang, Khet Phra Nakhon, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10200, Thailand

description_en: Step through the gate and forget you're in Bangkok 🎋 Kitaohji Ginza brings 90 years of Tokyo kaiseki tradition to Thonglor — a bamboo garden, koi pond, and serene Japanese house set the stage before the first dish even arrives. Seasonal multi-course kaiseki featuring hairy crab, wagyu, and uni, prepared by Japanese chefs with quiet precision. One of Bangkok's most genuinely transportive fine dining experiences.
description_zh: 通羅最讓人忘記身在曼谷的地方 🎋 Kitaohji Ginza Thailand 是來自東京銀座、擁有 90 年歷史的懷石料理名店，竹林、錦鯉池、禪意庭園讓你踏入門便瞬間切換時空，季節性多道菜套餐以毛蟹、和牛、海膽依序登場，是曼谷最貼近日本本土懷石體驗的餐廳。
address: 212 Soi Thong Lo, Khwaeng Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

name_en: MAGURO @Marché Thonglor | Japanese Dining and Bar
name_zh: MAGURO @Marché Thonglor | Japanese Dining and Bar
description_en: Thonglor's most serene Japanese dining corner 🍣 MAGURO on the second floor of Marché Thonglor is a Zen-styled retreat amid the greenery — premium sushi and Japanese dishes like Engawa Don, deep-sea Nodoguro, and crispy soft shell crab salad, all crafted with quality ingredients. The kind of spot where you slow down, order carefully, and leave very happy.
description_zh: 通羅最療癒的日式角落 🍣 MAGURO 藏在 Marché Thonglor 二樓的綠意空間裡，禪風設計搭上精緻擺盤，Engawa Don、Nodoguro 白身魚、軟殼蟹沙拉道道用高級食材說話，想在通羅找一個安靜享用好壽司的地方，就是這裡了。
address: Floor 2, Zone A, 144/4 Soi Thong Lo, Khwaeng Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: Twelve seats, one unforgettable counter 🍣 Sushi Yorokobu is led by Master Chef Tango Lai — awarded Best of the Best Master Chef in Hong Kong two years running — with ingredients flown fresh from Japan weekly. Traditional Edomae technique meets modern creativity: silky uni, extraordinary abalone, and monkfish liver that regulars still talk about. An intimate omakase where every knife stroke feels personal.
description_zh: 12 個座位、一生難忘的那種壽司 🍣 Sushi Yorokobu 由香港「年度最佳主廚」Tango Lai 掌刀，食材每週直飛自日本，傳統江戶前技法融入現代創意，海膽甜而鮮、鮑魚驚艷無比，面對主廚席的親密感讓每一道都像是專屬你的表演。
address: 10 Soi Thong Lo, Khwaeng Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: Hand rolls with omakase-level soul 🌊 Kozuri at theCOMMONS Thonglor is a modern handroll bar where every bite is made to order — crispy seaweed, generous fillings, and a signature Kozuri Roll with chutoro, uni, and truffle sauce that's worth the trip alone. Seven rolls for 1,290 baht, eaten at the counter in one of Thonglor's most laid-back outdoor spaces. Casual, fresh, and deeply satisfying.
description_zh: 手卷也可以有 Omakase 靈魂 🌊 Kozuri Hand Roll 藏在 theCOMMONS 通羅一樓，海苔現烤酥脆、食材飽滿鮮美，招牌 Kozuri Roll 以中腹鮪魚、海膽、松露醬一口滿足，7 卷 1290 銖就能吃到飽，午後坐在露天空間慢慢享用，是通羅最輕鬆的日式體驗。
address: 335 Soi Thong Lo, Khwaeng Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: Osaka Michelin pedigree, now in Ekkamai 🍱 Sho is the personal expression of Chef Shoto Izaki — trained for five years at the sister restaurant of Michelin-starred Osaka Restaurant Asai. Seasonal kaiseki-inspired courses, honmaguro yukke don, and perfectly glazed unagi kabayaki, served in a warm wood-toned space with private dining available. Refined without being stiff, and one of Bangkok's most quietly impressive Japanese dining rooms.
description_zh: 大阪米其林血統在 Ekkamai 落地生根 🍱 Sho 由主廚 Shoto Izaki 主理，師承大阪米其林星餐廳 Asai，懷石料理底蘊融入現代日式風格，本鮪魚泥丼、鰻魚蒲燒、季節性套餐道道精緻，木質溫暖空間兼有包廂，是 Ekkamai 最值得慶祝的日式餐廳。
address: 88/1 Eight Thonglor 55 Sukhumvit Rd, Khwaeng Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: Osaka's 1907 fish market legend — Bangkok's only overseas branch 🍣 Endo Sushi at The Taste Thonglor brings four generations of sushi craft from Osaka Central Fish Market to Bangkok. Thick-cut fish on hand-warm, malty rice, brushed lightly with soy — no blowtorches, no theatrics, just proper nigiri done right. Five pieces from 450 baht, kimono-clad staff, and a hushed counter atmosphere that makes the mall outside disappear entirely.
description_zh: 大阪中央魚市場百年壽司名店，唯一海外分店就在通羅 🍣 Endo Sushi 自 1907 年傳承至今，澱粉香氣十足的醋飯上放上厚切生魚片，五貫一套才 450 銖，穿著和服的服務生輕聲穿梭，少了炭烤噱頭、多了對傳統的誠摯，是曼谷最接近大阪壽司台本味的地方。
address: The Taste Thong Lo, Khwaeng Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: Thonglor's most quietly refined Japanese kappo 🎋 Miyabi Kappo hides on Thong Lo Soi 25 in a space converted from a dojo — premium ingredients flown from Japan, seasonal hairy crab, Genki fish, and A5 wagyu that change with the seasons. Mostly frequented by Japanese regulars who know what they're doing. The kind of restaurant where the service alone is worth the visit.
description_zh: 通羅最低調的日本料亭 🎋 Miyabi Kappo 藏在通羅 25 巷道場改建的空間裡，食材直飛自日本，松葉蟹、毛蟹、A5 和牛隨季節更迭，服務細膩周到，是曼谷日籍客人最愛聚餐的私藏地，也是曼谷最接近日本料亭待客之道的地方。
address: 9 11 Soi Saeng Ngoen, Khwaeng Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: A Fukuoka izakaya that landed in Thonglor 🍶 照 Terra is run by a Japanese chef from Fukuoka, and the menu feels genuinely Hakata — sesame-marinated amberjack, creamy oyster hot pot, liver sashimi, and pork offal stew that regulars keep ordering twice. Counter seating facing the open kitchen, cold beer, no rush. The kind of Japanese spot that Japanese people actually go to.
description_zh: 福岡居酒屋的靈魂，藏在通羅巷弄裡 🍶 照 Terra 由福岡主廚主理，芝麻醬漬鰤魚、生蠔奶油熱鍋、新鮮生肝刺身道道是日本本土滋味，吧台座位面對開放廚房，冷一杯啤酒、慢慢點小菜，是曼谷日本居酒屋中最有博多靈魂的一間。
address: 111/4 Thanon Ekkamai, Khwaeng Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

name_en: เฮียด่วน Hereduan - 段哥 Thai Street food
name_zh: เฮียด่วน Hereduan - 段哥 Thai Street food
description_en: Ekkamai's most characterful Thai street food joint 🦀 เฮียด่วน hides inside a retro-art space filled with vintage collectibles and a speakeasy jazz vibe — worlds away from a typical street stall. The creamy crab omelette rice bowl is the signature: rich, garlicky, peppery, and loaded with fresh prawns. Portions are generous, prices slightly above street-food standard, and every dish punches well above its weight.
description_zh: Ekkamai 最有個性的泰式街頭食堂 🦀 เฮียด่วน 藏在復古藝術空間裡，牆上掛滿老物件、爵士樂輕輕流瀉，招牌奶油螃蟹炒蛋飯香氣四溢、份量十足，打拋豬、炒河粉道道鑊氣夠勁，比普通街頭小炒貴一點，但每一口都值得。
address: เขตวั ฒนา 32 ซ. เอกมัย 21 Khwaeng Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: Thai food, done exactly as it should be 🌾 KHAO means rice, and the philosophy is just as grounding — five consecutive Michelin stars, a rice-barn-inspired dining room with warm wood and natural light, and a menu of 90+ Thai classics made with premium ingredients and zero compromise. Crab roe chilli paste, Panang prawn curry, creamy crab omelette. No fusion, no theatrics, just the best version of dishes you already love. Come in a group of four or five to do the menu justice.
description_zh: 泰菜就該是這個樣子 🌾 KHAO 以「米」為名，五年連續米其林一星，餐廳靈感取自傳統穀倉，木質空間透進自然光，招牌螃蟹卵辣椒醬配鯖魚、帕南咖哩蝦、螃蟹炒蛋道道精緻純粹，不花俏、不融合，只是把泰菜本質做到最好。
address: 15 Soi Charoen Mit, Khwaeng Khlong Tan Nuea, Khlongtun Nua, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

name_en: เฮงหอยทอด - เอกมัย
name_zh: เฮงหอยทอด - เอกมัย
description_en: One of CNN's top 5 street foods in the world 🦪 Heng Hoi Tod Chaw Lae has been frying oyster omelettes the right way for decades — crispy batter that stays crispy, plump fresh oysters, and a dipping sauce that ties it all together. The Ekkamai branch sits right at Soi 14, with Pad Thai Tom Yum and mussel omelette rounding out a menu that Bangkok locals grew up eating. All for under 200 baht.
description_zh: CNN 評選全球五大街頭小吃就是這個 🦪 เฮงหอยทอดชาวเล 蚵仔煎酥脆不吸油、海瓜子鮮甜飽滿、Pad Thai Tom Yum 酸辣夠勁，在 Ekkamai 14 巷口吃一盤才百來銖，是曼谷人從小吃到大的那種味道。
address: 128 3 Soi Lukson Daeng, Khwaeng Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: Ekkamai's freshest night market, right by the BTS 🎵 Johnny Market just opened next to the Eastern Bus Terminal on Ekkamai Road — food trucks, premium street food, standout dishes like five-cheese pizza and crab noodles, and DJ sets that keep the energy going until 1am. Organized, well-lit, and already a local favourite. The kind of market you stumble into for one dish and stay for three more.
description_zh: Ekkamai 最新開幕的夜市就在 BTS 旁 🎵 Johnny Market 就在 Ekkamai 東部巴士站旁，食物車、精品街頭小吃、五起司披薩、螃蟹麵一字排開，DJ 音樂整晚不停歇，開到凌晨一點，是 Ekkamai 最好逛、最好吃的新夜市。
address: 928, แขวงพระโขนง เขตคลองเตย กรุงเทพมหานคร 10110, Thailand

name_en: ซาวเอกมัย ZAO EKKAMAI
name_zh: ซาวเอกมัย ZAO EKKAMAI
description_en: Isaan soul food, reframed with designer intention 🌶️ ZAO started in Ubon Ratchathani and brought its boldest flavours to a charming mid-century house in Ekkamai Soi 25. The name means "search for whatever's there and cook it" — and the menu delivers: watermelon in fermented fish sauce, red ant egg omelette, sun-dried beef, grilled snakehead fish. Authentic, seasonal, and unlike anywhere else in Bangkok. Reservations recommended, cashless only.
description_zh: 不用去東北，在 Ekkamai 就能吃到靈魂級的伊善菜 🌶️ ZAO 由設計師老闆娘從烏汶府帶來，「ซาว」在伊善話意為「找到什麼就拿什麼來做」，西瓜配發酵魚醬、螞蟻卵炒蛋、烤牛舌，每道都是食材與文化的故事，百年老屋改建空間溫暖有質感，不收現金。
address: 155 ซ. ปรีดี พนมยงค์ 25 Khwaeng Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: Bangkok's benchmark for green papaya salad 🌶️ Somtam Nua has been the city's go-to Isaan spot for decades — fiery, tangy som tam that hits every note, charcoal-grilled pork neck that's tender with a smoky char, and fried chicken wings that regulars order every single visit. Served alongside black and white sticky rice, at prices that make it impossible not to come back. A Bangkok lunch essential.
description_zh: 曼谷最好吃的青木瓜沙拉就在這裡 🌶️ Somtam Nua 在 Siam 一帶深耕多年，青木瓜沙拉酸辣爽脆、烤豬頸肉嫩而焦香、炸雞翅酥脆到骨，配上黑白糯米飯一起吃才完整，價格親民、翻桌快，曼谷人午餐就是要來這一頓。
address: Soi Sukhumvit 63, Khwaeng Phra Khanong Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: The crab omelette Bangkok locals prefer over Jay Fai 🦀 Nhong Rim Klong sits canal-side on Ekkamai Soi 21 — Michelin Bib Gourmand, no hype, just generous portions of fresh seafood at street food prices. The crab meat omelette is twice the size and half the price of the more famous version across town. Pad kee mao crab, creamy tom yum, stir-fried mantis shrimp — come in a group of four and work through the menu properly.
description_zh: 不用排 Jay Fai，螃蟹炒蛋一樣驚艷 🦀 Nhong Rim Klong 藏在 Ekkamai 運河邊，米其林 Bib Gourmand 加持，螃蟹炒蛋份量是 Jay Fai 兩倍、價格只有一半，蟹肉飽滿鮮甜、鑊氣十足，冬蔭功鮮辣夠味，來四人才能點得盡興。
address: 51 Soi Ekkamai 23, Khwaeng Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

name_en: SUMDAY Dimsum Park Silom - ซัมเดย์ติ่มซำ ปาร์ค สีลม
name_zh: SUMDAY Dimsum Park Silom - ซัมเดย์ติ่มซำ ปาร์ค สีลม
description_en: Silom's newest all-day dim sum bar 🥟 SUMDAY just opened on the ground floor of Park Silom — a Hong Kong-style dim sum counter where everything is made fresh in an open kitchen right in front of you. Plump har gow, generous fillings, and an 8-piece omakase set from 345 baht that covers all the signatures. Pair with Chinese tea and take your time. The kind of spot that makes any hour feel like dim sum hour.
description_zh: 矽隆鬧區的港式飲茶新據點 🥟 SUMDAY Dimsum 剛在 Park Silom 一樓開幕，開放式廚房現包現蒸、每籠都看得見，蝦餃皮薄餡飽、8 件套餐 345 銖起，Omakase 套餐讓你一次嚐遍招牌，配一壺中國茶，任何時間都是下午茶時光。
address: G Floor, 1 Convent Rd, สีลม, Khet Bang Rak, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10500, Thailand

description_en: Chinatown's most honest Hong Kong noodle shop 🦆 Tucked on a side street off Yaowarat, HongKong Dimsum and Noodle is no-frills done exactly right — open kitchen, plastic stools, metal tables, and wonton noodles that regulars call the best in Bangkok. Crispy roast duck, shrimp siu mai, and wonton mee from 50 baht. Packed with locals at lunch for good reason. The kind of place where the food does all the talking.
description_zh: 唐人街巷弄裡最樸實的港式滋味 🦆 HongKong Dimsum and Noodle 藏在耀華力小巷轉角，開放式廚房看得見師傅現做，雲吞麵湯底清甜鮮美、脆皮燒鴨油亮焦香、蝦餃皮薄Q彈，塑膠凳子、金屬桌面，一碗才 50 銖，午市擠滿本地人才是最好的保證。
address: Talat Yot, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

description_en: All the dim sum joy, none of the queue 🐉 Little Dragon on Charoenkrung Road is the neighbourhood's best-kept secret — 14 dim sum varieties at just 40 baht each, including silky hakao, Emperor Salted Egg shumai, and crispy fried tofu skin that's impossible to stop at one plate. Two people, 11 dishes, 600 baht. The perfect alternative when the famous queue at Tuang next door is too long to bear.
description_zh: 不想排隊也能吃到好飲茶 🐉 Little Dragon 就在 Charoenkrung 44 巷旁，14 款飲茶每款才 40 銖，蝦餃皮薄透亮、鹹蛋肉末燒賣是必點，炸腐皮酥脆過癮，兩人點 11 道才 600 銖，是逃離 Tuang 排隊人龍的最佳替代方案。
address: ใกล้ 1464 Soi Charoen Krung 44, Khwaeng Bang Rak, Khet Bang Rak, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10500, Thailand

description_en: The Cantonese gem hiding across from CentralWorld 🥟 same kitchen soul, new neighbourhood. Peking duck with crackling skin, BBQ pork rice noodle rolls, and crispy turnip cake that regulars keep ordering. The perfect dim sum stop after a day at the mall, done the right way.
description_zh: Central World 對面的廣式飲茶新據點 🥟 由耀華力原店班底打造，招牌北京烤鴨皮脆入魂、叉燒腸粉鮮嫩多汁、豬排蘿蔔糕外酥內綿，適合購物完後轉角坐下來慢慢品茶點，鬧市中難得的廣式休憩時光。
address: โรงแรมอโนมา ชั้นที่ 2 เลขที่ 99 Thanon Ratchadamri, ลุมพินี Pathum Wan, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10330, Thailand

description_en: Hong Kong's most iconic Chinese restaurant, now at MahaNakhon 🦆 Mott 32 takes its name from the address of New York's first Chinese grocery in 1851, and brings that same sense of history to The Standard Bangkok. Art deco meets Chinoiserie, with a menu to match — tableside carved Peking duck, Iberico BBQ pork buns, truffle siu mai with quail egg. Bold Cantonese flavors, premium ingredients, and a room that makes the occasion feel special every time.
description_zh: 香港頂級中餐品牌在 MahaNakhon 落腳 🦆 Mott 32 以紐約莫特街 1851 年第一家中國雜貨店為名，裝潢融合裝飾藝術與清代風情，北京烤鴨皮脆肉嫩桌邊片鴨、Iberico 豬叉燒包鬆軟流汁、松露鵪鶉蛋燒賣道道精緻，是曼谷最有型格的粵菜體驗。
address: 2nd Floor, The Standard, 114 Thanon Naradhiwat Rajanagarindra, Si Lom, Khet Bang Rak, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10500, Thailand

description_en: Silom's best-value all-you-can-eat dim sum 🥟 Yu Her Bao sits inside Mercure Bangkok Surawong — an elegant jade-inspired space with a dim sum buffet of 50+ selections, three hours unlimited, with free-flow Chinese tea throughout. Silky chee cheong fun, plump har gow, crispy pan-fried chive cake, and Cantonese classics done with care. A seriously good deal in a polished setting.
description_zh: 矽隆最值得一試的廣式飲茶吃到飽 🥟 Yu Her Bao 藏在 Mercure Bangkok Surawong 裡，以翡翠為靈感的雅緻空間，超過 50 種飲茶任點三小時，腸粉嫩滑、蝦餃飽滿、韭菜煎糕外酥內軟，搭配無限續茶，是矽隆最超值的廣東料理體驗。
address: 222 Surawong Rd, Khwaeng Si Phraya, Khet Bang Rak, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10500, Thailand

description_en: A refined mainland Chinese kitchen above Erawan Bangkok 🥢 Man Ho Bistro draws inspiration from Sichuan and Shandong provinces — bold spice, earthy depth, and comfort cooking done with elegance. Honey-glazed pork ribs, Hakka-style stuffed tofu, and Peking duck on the dinner menu, plus weekend dim sum with scallop dumplings and abalone soup. Tucked on the second floor of Erawan Bangkok, steps from Chit Lom BTS. The kind of Chinese restaurant you bring someone to celebrate.
description_zh: Erawan Bangkok 二樓的四川山東中菜小館 🥢 Man Ho Bistro 靈感源自中國大陸腹地風味，四川麻辣與山東豪邁在此交匯，蜜汁炭烤豬肋排、客家釀豆腐、北京烤鴨道道用心，周末飲茶供應扇貝芋頭餃、鮑魚湯，Chit Lom BTS 旁最精緻的中菜小酌之所。
address: 494 Thanon Phloen Chit, Khwaeng Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10330, Thailand

description_en: Thonglor's most smile-worthy brunch spot 😊 NICO NICO means "smile" in Japanese, and the vibe delivers — Japanese minimalism meets Scandinavian warmth, with an artisan Bakery Lab where you can watch bread being made fresh. The signature Yudane Toast has a pillowy, chewy texture that sets it apart, and the wasabi crab toast is a must. Quiet, curated, and open from 8am. The kind of café you discover once and make a habit.
description_zh: 通羅最微笑的早午餐咖啡廳 😊 NICO NICO 在日文裡是微笑的意思，日式極簡混北歐溫暖的空間裡，Yudane 湯種麵包 Q 彈綿密、咖哩炒蛋搭叉燒培根讓人一早就開心，山葵蟹肉吐司是必點，Bakery Lab 透明廚房看師傅現做，平日早晨一個人來也舒服。
address: 555, ตึก DM Home Soi Thong Lo, แขวง คลองเตยเหนือ Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: Thonglor's most-loved all-day breakfast 🥞 Breakfast Story is rooted in the classic North American diner — proper ingredients from the start: organic eggs, real maple syrup, real butter, fresh fruit. Fluffy pancakes, eggs Benedict, caramelized French toast, and bottomless brewed coffee from 7am to 11pm. Generous portions, friendly English-speaking staff, and a second-floor spot across from Euro Creations. The kind of breakfast that makes you forget you're in Bangkok.
description_zh: 通羅早餐控的口袋名單 🥞 Breakfast Story 由加拿大人打造，從早上七點到晚上十一點全天供應，有機雞蛋、真楓糖漿、希臘優格樣樣講究，班尼迪克蛋、厚鬆餅、豐盛早餐拼盤份量大得剛好，無限續杯熱咖啡是在曼谷最舒服的一個早晨。
address: 154 Soi Thong Lo, Khwaeng Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: Thonglor's most fire-driven kitchen 🔥 STOKE on Thonglor Soi 6 is built around twin grills, a Josper charcoal oven, and a multi-layer brick firepit — every dish carries genuine flame-kissed depth. Blackened brick chicken, slow-cooked lamb, ricotta gnocchi with chorizo, and five house-made hot sauces with real personality. Three dining zones including a buzzy open-kitchen atrium, and open until midnight. Bangkok's most exciting new fire kitchen.
description_zh: 通羅最燃的火焰廚房 🔥 STOKE 藏在通羅 6 巷，以雙烤爐、Josper 炭窯、多層磚砌火坑為靈魂，炭烤壓扁雞、慢燉羊肉、木柴烤 Gnocchi 道道帶焦香煙燻，五款自製辣醬各有個性，三個用餐區從開放廚房到私人包廂，開到午夜，是通羅最有火氣的新餐廳。
address: 160/20-21 Thonglor Soi Thong Lo, Khwaeng Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

name_en: Lucca Thonglor – Mediterranean Restaurant, Rooftop & All-Day Brunch
name_zh: Lucca Thonglor – Mediterranean Restaurant, Rooftop & All-Day Brunch
description_en: A Mediterranean hideaway at the mouth of Thonglor Soi 7 🌿 Lucca is all bamboo, white concrete, and warm hidden lighting — the kind of space that makes you slow down the moment you walk in. All-day brunch from 7am with chili egg benedict, chicken kebab with hummus, and a lava tiramisu that's worth the trip alone. Rooftop evenings for intimate pizza nights and private events above the city. One space, many hours, always a good reason to stay.
description_zh: 通羅 7 巷口的地中海秘境 🌿 Lucca 竹木建材混白牆，宛如地中海小屋搬進通羅，全日早午餐從早七點開始，辣雞蛋班尼迪克、雞肉捲餅、熔岩提拉米蘇道道用心，頂樓露台入夜後化身披薩派對與私人聚會場地，從早餐到夜晚，每個時刻都有自己的節奏。
address: Thonglor, 125/26 Soi Thong Lo, Khwaeng Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: Sipping coffee in a million-baht chair ☕ Café Craft is tucked inside CHANINTR's flagship showroom on Thonglor Road — Louis Poulsen lighting, Carl Hansen chairs, terrazzo floors, and single-origin coffee served in a space that makes you want to redecorate your home. Avocado toast, French toast with caramelized banana, biodynamic wines, and a shaded garden where pets are welcome. The most beautiful café in Bangkok that you're technically inside a furniture store.
description_zh: 坐在百萬名椅上喝咖啡，這才叫生活 ☕ Café Craft 藏在 CHANINTR 奢華家具展示間一樓，Louis Poulsen 燈具、Carl Hansen 木椅環繞四周，單品咖啡、焦糖法式吐司、有機食材早午餐，花園區可攜帶毛小孩，是通羅最有質感的秘密下午。
address: 924 Soi Thong Lo, Khwaeng Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

name_en: D'ARK The Strand - Comfort Food & Specialty Coffee
name_zh: D'ARK The Strand - Comfort Food & Specialty Coffee
description_en: Thonglor's most stylish all-day café and kitchen ☕ D'ARK The Strand home-roasts its own specialty coffee and pairs it with comfort food done properly — tiger prawn spaghetti, Black Angus steak and fries, acai bowls, banana pancakes. Pet-friendly outdoor terrace, live music after sunset, and open from 7am through the night. The kind of spot where you come for coffee and end up staying for dinner.
description_zh: 通羅最有型的全天候咖啡餐廳 ☕ D'ARK The Strand 自家烘焙精品咖啡、虎蝦義大利麵、黑安格斯牛排、酪梨吐司，室內室外座位都有設計感，寵物友善花園、傍晚現場樂團接手，從早上七點到深夜，什麼時間來都對味。
address: 36, 190 Soi Thong Lo, แขวง คลองเตยเหนือ, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: The brunch institution that started it all at theCOMMONS ☕ ROAST has been Bangkok's benchmark for quality all-day dining for over a decade — everything made in-house by their own chefs, bakers, and coffee roasters. Truffle alfredo, duck hash browns, Turkish eggs, banana-stuffed French toast, and a signature coffee with espresso ice cubes that slowly melt into warm milk. The kind of café that earns its queue every single weekend.
description_zh: 通羅 theCOMMONS 最老牌的早午餐信仰 ☕ ROAST 自家烘焙、自家烘培，松露奶油義大利麵、鴨肉薯餅、土耳其炒蛋每道都像是精心設計的作品，招牌咖啡冰塊以咖啡製成、注入溫牛奶後慢慢融化，是曼谷早午餐界十年不敗的定番。
address: The COMMONS, 335 ชั้น 3 Soi Thong Lo 17, Khwaeng Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: Bangkok's best-value rooftop night out 🌆 Perched on the 9th floor of Novotel Bangkok Platinum in Pratunam, View Rooftop serves up Mediterranean sharing plates, creative cocktails, and panoramic city views — all to a soundtrack of deep house, nu-disco, and funky beats. Free-flow drinks from 499 baht for two hours, fire show performances, and staff that make every visit feel like a celebration. Arrive at sunset and you won't want to leave.
description_zh: 曼谷天際線下最划算的夜晚 🌆 View Rooftop 坐落 Novotel Bangkok Platinum 9 樓，地中海料理配上全景天際線，DJ 播著 Deep House 與 Nu-Disco，499 銖暢飲兩小時、還有噴火表演，日落入座、深夜不想離去。
address: 9th Floor, Novotel Bangkok, Platinum Pratunam, 220 Thanon Phetchaburi, Khwaeng Thanon Phetchaburi, Khet Ratchathewi, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10400, Thailand

description_en: Bangkok's most colourful rooftop escape, 25 floors above Siam 🌴🩷 Paradise Lost at Siam@Siam Design Hotel is a neo-tropical sanctuary of candy pink sofas, lush greenery, and 360-degree skyline views stretching to Wat Saket and Wat Arun. Cuban head bartender Julio crafts sustainable cocktails using local herbs and closed-loop spirits, while live performances set the mood nightly. Happy hour daily from 6–8pm, and prices that make it one of Bangkok's most accessible rooftop experiences. The hidden gem that still feels like one.
description_zh: 曼谷最美的新熱帶秘境在 25 樓等你 🌴🩷 Paradise Lost 藏在 Siam@Siam 酒店頂樓，粉紅沙發、熱帶植物、360 度天際線，古巴籍調酒師以永續食材調製的雞尾酒道道有個性，Wat Saket 與 IconSiam 就在視線裡，每晚 6–8 點 Happy Hour、現場表演接力，是 Siam 一帶最不像曼谷的那一個夜晚。
address: 865 Rama I Rd, Khwaeng Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10330, Thailand

name_en: Sanay Rooftop Bar Khaosan - เสน่ห์ รูฟท็อป บาร์ ข้าวสาร
name_zh: Sanay Rooftop Bar Khaosan - เสน่ห์ รูฟท็อป บาร์ ข้าวสาร
description_en: Steps from Khao San chaos, worlds away in atmosphere 🌅 Sanay Rooftop Bar sits on the 6th floor of The Gravitique Hotel on Tani Road — offering Old Town sunset views, creative handcrafted cocktails, and a Thai tea crème brûlée that regulars can't stop ordering. Music at conversation level, retractable roof for rainy nights, live bands on weeknights, and staff who genuinely make you feel at home. The rare Khao San spot where you actually want to linger.
description_zh: 考山路喧囂就在腳下，這裡卻安靜得剛好 🌅 Sanay Rooftop 藏在 The Gravitique Hotel 6 樓，俯瞰曼谷老城夕陽，招牌 Sanay 雞尾酒、Espresso Martini、泰式鳳梨炒飯道道好評，音樂音量剛好可以聊天，還有可伸縮屋頂應對雨天，是離考山最近卻逃離得最徹底的地方。
address: 19 Thanon Tani, Khwaeng Talat Yot, Khet Phra Nakhon, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10200, Thailand

description_en: Bangkok street food, elevated to the 39th floor 🌆 Bangkok Heightz at The Continent Hotel in Asoke offers panoramic city views alongside a menu rooted in Thai street food tradition — standout tom yum, rich green curry, and signature cocktails inspired by local herbs and spices. Weekend DJ sets, live performances on the rooftop, and staff that reviewers keep mentioning by name. A rooftop experience that feels personal rather than pretentious.
description_zh: 把泰式街頭美食送上天際 🌆 Bangkok Heightz 坐落 The Continent Hotel 頂樓，Tom Yum 湯鮮辣到位、綠咖哩濃郁香醇、百香果雞尾酒招牌必點，週末 DJ 進駐、「Lyrics on the Roof」現場演出，是 Asoke 一帶最有溫度的空中餐廳。
address: 413 ชั้น 39, โรงแรม เดอะ คอนทิเนนท์, Sukhumvit Rd, Khwaeng Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

name_en: Blue Sky Rooftop Restaurant & Bar at Centara Grand at Central Plaza Ladprao Bangkok
name_zh: Blue Sky Rooftop Restaurant & Bar at Centara Grand at Central Plaza Ladprao Bangkok
description_en: Ladprao's most breathtaking rooftop celebration spot 🌃 Blue Sky Rooftop sits on the 24th floor of Centara Grand at Central Plaza Ladprao — unobstructed panoramic views over Chatuchak Park and Bangkok's glittering skyline, without tall buildings crowding the view. French-inspired contemporary cuisine, a 400-day aged Wagyu steak that regulars keep coming back for, and neon blue lighting that makes the whole evening feel like a dream. One of Bangkok's most underrated rooftop experiences, and staff who consistently go the extra mile.
description_zh: Ladprao最值得慶祝的 24 樓夜景 🌃 Blue Sky Rooftop 坐落 Centara Grand 頂樓，恰圖恰公園綠意盡收眼底、曼谷夜景一望無際，400 天熟成和牛、法式創意料理、精釀雞尾酒，霓虹藍燈打出夢幻氛圍，不像其他天空酒吧被高樓環繞，視野開闊得讓人捨不得移開目光。
address: 1695 Centara Grand at Central plaza, Ladprao, 24 Fl, แขวงจตุจักร เขตจตุจักร กรุงเทพมหานคร 10900, Thailand

description_en: Chao Phraya River views without the rooftop bar price tag 🌊 Perched on the 8th and 9th floors of Hotel Once in Charoen Krung, Top Knot offers two levels of riverside dining — a botanical-themed terrace below and an open rooftop above. The mushroom soup has its own fanbase, the grilled salmon with béarnaise is a must, and cocktails come with a buy-two-get-one deal. Arrive at sunset when the river turns gold. One of Bangkok's best-kept value rooftop secrets.
description_zh: 昭披耶河景盡收眼底，價格卻親民得不像話 🌊 Top Knot 藏在 Hotel Once 的 8–9 樓，植物園風格露台搭上河景，奶油蘑菇湯被評為曼谷最好喝、烤鮭魚配白汁奶油醬令人難忘，雞尾酒買兩送一，夕陽入座、河面染金，是曼谷最超值的河畔天台。
address: 2074 99 Soi Charoen Krung 72/2, Khwaeng Wat Phraya Krai, Khet Bang Kho Laem, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10120, Thailand

description_en: The most romantic rooftop on the Chao Phraya 🌊 Dark Waters perches atop Ten Six Hundred on the Thonburi riverbank — slow boats drifting past, the occasional IconSiam fireworks in the distance, and a quiet sophistication that's rare for Bangkok. Signature cocktails Dark Waters and Earthquake, salmon steak, seafood pizza, and tom yum spaghetti, all to a live jazz soundtrack. The kind of rooftop that turns a regular Tuesday into a memory.
description_zh: 昭披耶河上最浪漫的靜謐夜晚 🌊 Dark Waters 坐落 Ten Six Hundred 頂樓，河上船隻緩緩駛過、IconSiam 煙火偶爾在遠方綻放，招牌調酒 Dark Waters 與 Earthquake 各有個性，鮭魚排、Tom Yum 義大利麵道道驚喜，Live Jazz 輕輕流瀉，是曼谷最適合慶祝紀念日的那一種屋頂。
address: 29, 2 Soi Charoen Nakhon 39, Khwaeng Bang Lamphu Lang, Khet Khlong San, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10600, Thailand

description_en: Mediterranean dolce vita, 22 floors above Sukhumvit 11 🍋 Pastel at AIRA Hotel is led by Swiss Michelin-starred Chef Kilian Fioretto, who fuses bold Mediterranean flavours with vibrant Asian ingredients. Truffle fettuccine, sea urchin croquettes, salt-crusted sea bass — all designed for sharing under bamboo archways and Rivera-tiled terraces. Live DJ with saxophone, free-flow Champagne for ladies, buy-one-get-one oysters all night. Bangkok's most festive sky bar, and one of its most delicious.
description_zh: 地中海熱情搬上曼谷 22 樓 🍋 Pastel 藏在 AIRA Sukhumvit 11，米其林星級主廚 Kilian 以亞洲食材詮釋地中海風味，松露義大利麵、鮮蠔、鹽焗鱸魚道道精彩，竹製拱廊、River瓷磚裝飾，DJ 加 Sax 現場演奏，入夜後是曼谷天空最歡樂的派對現場。
address: 22nd floor, Aira Hotel, 14 Soi Sukhumvit 11, Khwaeng Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: The best Thai food just a short walk from Khao San 🌿 The Family sits canal-side under old trees in Phra Nakhon — green curry, pad thai, mango sticky rice and spring rolls that regulars say are the best in Bangkok, all for 50–80 baht a dish. Mosquito spray and UNO cards on every table, fairy lights in the trees, and a family who genuinely treats every guest like one of their own. The kind of place you stumble upon and keep coming back to.
description_zh: 考山路走幾步就有這麼好吃的家常泰菜 🌿 The Family 藏在運河邊的老樹下，綠咖哩、Pad Thai、芒果糯米飯每道才 50–80 銖，桌上備有防蚊噴霧和 UNO 牌，老闆一家人親切招呼，樹燈把河岸夜晚映得格外溫柔，是考山附近最有家的感覺的地方。
address: 1 6 Prachathipatai Rd, Khwaeng Ban Phan Thom, Khet Phra Nakhon, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10200, Thailand

name_en: Myth I Bangkok Street food | Best mango sticky rice
name_zh: Myth I Bangkok Street food | Best mango sticky rice
description_en: The best mango sticky rice find near Khao San 🥭 Myth I Bangkok on Chakrabongse Road is a casual, welcoming street food spot that earned its 4.7 Google rating the honest way — with perfectly ripe mango, velvety coconut sticky rice, and a Pad Thai that regulars came back four days in a row for. Vegetarian and vegan-friendly, open until midnight, and the kind of unpretentious place that makes every other mango sticky rice feel like a comparison.
description_zh: 考山路旁最值得繞進去的街頭食堂 🥭 Myth I 藏在 Chakrabongse 路小巷，芒果糯米飯是招牌、鮮甜芒果配椰奶香糯米每口都讓人閉眼，Pad Thai、綠咖哩道道用心，友善素食客，開到午夜，Google 4.7 分、2000 則評價撐腰，來一次就回不去其他家。
address: 84 Chakrabongse Rd, Khwaeng Talat Yot, Khet Phra Nakhon, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10200, Thailand

description_en: The most welcoming Thai spot for vegetarians near Khao San 🥭 Panda Thai Food on Samsen Soi 2 earns its fans the old-fashioned way — fresh ingredients, generous portions, and staff who greet you with complimentary watermelon. The pineapple fried rice arrives in an actual pineapple, the mango sticky rice is the real deal, and the menu caters equally to meat-eaters and vegetarians. Friendly, affordable, and the perfect first meal in Bangkok.
description_zh: 考山路附近最友善素食者的泰菜小館 🥭 Panda Thai Food 藏在 Samsen 2 巷，鳳梨炒飯裝在整顆鳳梨裡端上桌、芒果糯米飯鮮甜滑嫩，入座就先送上西瓜，葷素都照顧到，一份才幾十銖，是旅人第一餐也不會踩雷的那種地方。
address: 196 Soi Samsen 2, Khwaeng Ban Phan Thom, Khet Phra Nakhon, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10200, Thailand

name_en: Aonchorn Thai restaurant ออนชอน ราชดำเนิน
name_zh: Aonchorn Thai restaurant ออนชอน ราชดำเนิน
description_en: A 4.9-rated pink shophouse gem near the Grand Palace 🌶️ ออนชอน on Prachathipatai Road is a beloved local haunt in Bangkok's old town — grilled pork with herb fish sauce dip, marinated beef, and northeastern-style salads that pack serious flavour for under 100 baht a dish.
